definition_zh: 理解；懂得；了解；体谅；认为；听说
definition_en: to know what something means or how it works, or to know another’s feelings
core_image: 站在对方的立场上，忽然看清了他说那句话时的处境
scene: 老师把学生的作业本翻过来，看到他昨天晚上在页边写的一行小字，语气软了下来。Now I understand why she left so early.
sceneCN: 这里 understand 是「理解、明白」（第 1 个义项：懂得含义或缘由）；句意为现在我明白她为什么这么早走了。站到对方位置上看清他的处境，正是这个词的画面。

derivatives.zh: 动词加 -ing 构成名词，义为「理解；谅解」
动词加 -able 构成形容词，义为「可以理解的」
加前缀 mis- 构成动词，义为「误解」

senses.title: To grasp the meaning of something
senses.definition: to know what words, rules, or ideas mean
senses.definitionCN: 知道文字、规则或想法的意思
senses.example: Do you understand the question?
senses.exampleCN: 你明白这个问题吗？
senses.why: The old verb stand means to be in place, so to understand is to stand in the place of a thing and see it from there.
senses.whyCN: 古语 stand 意为站立，understand 就是站到一件事的立场上去看它。

senses.title: To see the reason behind something
senses.definition: to know why something happened or was said
senses.definitionCN: 知道某事为何发生或被说出
senses.example: I understand now why he refused.
senses.exampleCN: 我现在明白他为什么拒绝了。
senses.why: Grasping a fact and grasping its reason are one act of standing in its place.
senses.whyCN: 抓住一个事实与抓住它的缘由，是同一个「站到它位置上」的动作。

senses.title: To know another person’s feelings
senses.definition: to be aware of and accept how someone feels
senses.definitionCN: 察觉并接受某人的感受
senses.example: My parents do not always understand me.
senses.exampleCN: 父母并不总能理解我。
senses.why: When you stand where another stands, feeling comes before facts.
senses.whyCN: 站到别人的位置上，感受先于事实到来。

senses.title: To believe or be told
senses.definition: to have been informed that something is so
senses.definitionCN: 据告知而认为某事如此
senses.example: I understand that the meeting has been moved.
senses.exampleCN: 我听说会议改期了。
senses.why: What you have taken in as true is also what you stand under as information.
senses.whyCN: 你当作真的收进来的消息，也是你站在其下接受的信息。

senses.title: To supply a missing word mentally
senses.definition: to take a word as implied though it is not written
senses.definitionCN: 把未写出的词含在心里补上
senses.example: In this phrase the verb is understood.
senses.exampleCN: 在这个短语里那个动词是隐含的。
senses.why: The reader joins the writer by standing in the same place and filling the gap.
senses.whyCN: 读者站到作者的同一位置，把空缺补上，两端就此接合。

intro.en: The word is an Old English compound of standing under something.
intro.cn: 这个词是古英语复合词，意为站在某物之下。

items.en: Understandan is built from under and standan, to stand, and means to stand in the midst of.
items.cn: understandan 由 under 与 standan（站立）构成，意为「站在其中」。

items.en: The prefix here is close in force to inter, so the word means to be among a thing.
items.cn: 这里的前缀效力接近 inter，因此这个词意为「处于某物之中」。

items.en: Middle English understand has already narrowed toward knowing and comprehending.
items.cn: 中古英语中 understand 已经收窄到「知晓、领会」。

items.en: The past forms understood, both past and participle, are leveled in the modern period.
items.cn: 过去式与过去分词在现代统一为 understood。

items.en: The polite sense of believing what one is told is common in business letters.
items.cn: 表示「据闻」的客气义在商务信函里很常见。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers verbs built on stand, and the near-meaning group collects verbs of grasping meaning.
note.cn: 形近组汇集由 stand 构成的动词，近义组汇集表示领会意义的动词。

entries.definition: the ability to grasp and to be kind
to grasp something wrongly
to stand against and resist
to grasp fully
to seize mentally
to share another’s feeling
to take the wrong meaning

normalIntro.en: Stand under a thing and look up at it from there, and you know how it stands.
normalIntro.cn: 站到一件事的下面抬头去看，就知道它到底是怎么立的。

normal.en: Understand and withstand share the verb stand, one standing among, one standing against.
normal.cn: understand 与 withstand 共用 stand，一个是站在其中，一个是顶住。

normal.en: Comprehend and grasp both picture taking hold, while understand pictures taking a place.
normal.cn: comprehend 与 grasp 都像伸手抓住，understand 则像占住一个位置。

normal.en: Understanding is the noun and also means a friendly tolerance between people.
normal.cn: understanding 既是名词「理解」，也指人与人之间的体谅。

normal.en: Misunderstand adds mis- for a wrong stand, a look from the wrong place.
normal.cn: misunderstand 加 mis-，表示站错了位置、从错处去看。

normal.en: Understood serves as both past tense and past participle.
normal.cn: understood 同时充当过去式与过去分词。

abstract.en: Step into another person’s shoes without saying a word.
abstract.cn: 不说一句话，把脚伸进别人的鞋里。

abstract.en: Look back at your own remark from there and feel it change.
abstract.cn: 从那儿回头看自己那句话，会觉得它变了样。

abstract.en: Then put a missing word into a gap and watch the sentence close.
abstract.cn: 再往空缺里填一个词，看句子合上。

examples.en: I did not understand the instructions at first.
examples.cn: 一开始我没看懂这些说明。

examples.en: She understands how hard the decision was for you.
examples.cn: 她明白这个决定对你有多难。

examples.en: We understand that the office will close early today.
examples.cn: 我们听说办公室今天会提前关门。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「安的斯坦得」——安心地站在（stand）对方那边，自然就懂了。

root: 古英语 under（在其下／在其中）+ standan（站立），understandan 意为「站在其中」，过去式与过去分词均为 understood

sensesIntro.en: Each sense is a change of place: standing in a thing, in a reason, in a feeling, in a report, or in a gap.
sensesIntro.cn: 每个义项都是一次换位：站进一件事、一个缘由、一种感受、一则传闻，或一处空缺。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: standing where another stands and seeing what they see.
core.cn: 核心意象：站到别人站的地方，看见他所看见的。

branches.en: The language branch: meanings and implied words.
branches.cn: 语言分支：意义与隐含的词。

branches.en: The cause branch: why a thing happened.
branches.cn: 原因分支：事情为何发生。

branches.en: The people branch: standing inside another’s feeling.
branches.cn: 人分支：站进别人的感受里。

branches.en: The report branch: what one has taken in as true.
branches.cn: 传闻分支：被当作真而收进来的话。

branches.en: The plain classroom sense of getting the point.
branches.cn: 课堂里最普通的「听懂了」。

intro.en: Two native English pieces: a preposition of place and a verb of standing.
intro.cn: 两块土生英语部件：一个方位介词和一个站立的动词。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin source, so the Latin list stays empty.
latinIntro.cn: 此词没有拉丁语来源，故拉丁同源词一栏留空。

items.example: Under here means in the midst of.
items.exampleCN: 这里的 under 意为「处于其中」。

definition_zh: 单位；单元；部件；部队小单位；一元（计量的量）
definition_en: a single thing or group treated as one whole, especially in measuring or organizing
core_image: 一盒积木被分成一块一块，每块都算一个
scene: 装修师傅在图纸上把一间病房划成几个格子，每个格子单独计价。The flat is divided into three units.
sceneCN: 这里 unit 是「单元」（第 1 个义项：被当作整体的一个部分）；句意为这套房子被分成三个单元。积木一块一块各算一个，正是这个词的核心画面。

derivatives.zh: 同根动词，义为「联合；团结」
同根名词，义为「团结；统一」
同根形容词，义为「单一的；统一的」
同根动词，义为「统一；使一致」

senses.title: A single part counted as one
senses.definition: one of the parts into which a larger whole is divided for counting or planning
senses.definitionCN: 较大整体为计数或规划而划分出的一个部分
senses.example: The course is divided into twelve units.
senses.exampleCN: 这门课分成十二个单元。
senses.why: The root means one, so a unit is whatever is being counted as one.
senses.whyCN: 词根意为「一」，因此 unit 就是被算作「一个」的那个东西。

senses.title: A fixed amount used in measuring
senses.definition: a standard quantity used to express measurements
senses.definitionCN: 用于表达测量结果的标准量
senses.example: The metre is a unit of length.
senses.exampleCN: 米是长度单位。
senses.why: Measuring means chopping a continuous thing into countable ones, and each piece is a unit.
senses.whyCN: 测量就是把连续的量切成可数的一个个，每一个就是 unit。

senses.title: A piece of equipment or furniture
senses.definition: one item of equipment, or a piece that forms part of a machine
senses.definitionCN: 一台设备，或构成机器一部分的组件
senses.example: The cooling unit needs replacing every three years.
senses.exampleCN: 冷却装置每三年要更换一次。
senses.why: Machines are built from countable one-pieces, and the pieces keep the name.
senses.whyCN: 机器由可数的「一个个」拼成，这些部件也沿用了这个名字。

senses.title: A small group in an organization
senses.definition: a group that works as one body, especially in an army or hospital
senses.definitionCN: 作为一个整体行动的小组，尤指军队或医院中的
senses.example: A medical unit was sent to the mountain village.
senses.exampleCN: 一支医疗队被派往那个山村。
senses.why: Several people acting as one are, from outside, a single unit.
senses.whyCN: 几个人如同一个人那样行动，从外面看就是一个 unit。

senses.title: A private flat or building section
senses.definition: one separate living space or workshop within a larger building
senses.definitionCN: 较大建筑内一个独立的居住空间或车间
senses.example: They rented a small unit above the garage.
senses.exampleCN: 他们租了车库上方的一个小单元。
senses.why: A building can be cut into countable spaces, each of which stands alone.
senses.whyCN: 一栋房子可以被切成一个个可数的空间，每个空间各自独立。

intro.en: The word is a contraction of the Latin word for one, first used in English by mathematicians.
intro.cn: 这个词是拉丁语「一」的缩略形式，最早由英语中的数学家用起来。

items.en: Unus meant one, and unitas meant oneness.
items.cn: unus 意为「一」，unitas 意为「一体」。

items.en: English writers formed unit from the Latin root for use in arithmetic.
items.cn: 十六世纪的作者用这个拉丁词根造出 unit，用于算术。

items.en: It spread from numbers to any single part counted as one.
items.cn: 它从数字扩展到任何被算作一个的部分。

items.en: Military and medical units gave it an organizational sense.
items.cn: 军队与医疗机构中的 unit 赋予了它组织层面的意义。

items.en: Housing units and industrial units bring it into everyday building language.
items.cn: 住房单元与工业厂房单元让它进入日常的建筑语言。

note.en: The look-alike group holds the uni- family, and the near-meaning group covers parts and measures.
note.cn: 形近组是 uni- 词族，近义组覆盖部分与度量单位的说法。

entries.definition: to join together
the state of being one
one of a kind
to loosen a knot
entries.definitionCN: 解开（只是拼写相近，词源不同）

entries.definition: one thing in a list
a part of a larger whole
a unit or system for measuring
the complete thing

normalIntro.en: Everything here is one thing counted as one, whether a lesson, a metre, or a clinic team.
normalIntro.cn: 这里的一切都是被算作「一个」的东西，无论是一课、一米，还是一支医疗队。

normal.en: Uni- is one, and the word names one countable piece.
normal.cn: uni- 是「一」，这个词就指一个可数的部分。

normal.en: A unit of measurement is the phrase used in science lessons.
normal.cn: a unit of measurement 是科学课上用的说法。

normal.en: Unit price on a shop label tells you the cost of one item.
normal.cn: 商店标签上的 unit price 指单件的价钱。

normal.en: Unite is the verb, unity the state, unitarity the quality of being one.
normal.cn: unite 是动词，unity 是状态，unitarity 是一体的性质。

normal.en: Housing unit and industrial unit turn the word into a piece of property.
normal.cn: housing unit 与 industrial unit 让这个词变成一处房产。

abstract.en: Picture a row of building blocks, each one separate.
abstract.cn: 想象一排积木，每一块都独立。

abstract.en: See a ruler marked with even black lines.
abstract.cn: 看一把尺子上一道道匀称的黑线。

abstract.en: Hear a doctor say a team of four will come up the hill.
abstract.cn: 听医生说一支四人的小队会上山来。

examples.en: The factory produces a thousand units a week.
examples.cn: 这家工厂每周生产一千台设备。

examples.en: Kilogram is the base unit of mass in the metric system.
examples.cn: 千克是公制中的基本质量单位。

examples.en: Each unit in the block has its own small garden.
examples.cn: 这排房屋的每个单元都有自己的小花园。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「尤尼特」——尤尼是「一」，特指其中一份，就是一个单位。

root: 拉丁语 unus（一）的缩略形式，十六世纪英语借此词根造出 unit，用于算术与计量

sensesIntro.en: One countable piece works as a lesson, a metre, a machine part, a team, and a flat.
sensesIntro.cn: 一个可数的部分，既是一课、一米，也是零件、小队与一套房。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a box of blocks separated into single pieces.
core.cn: 核心意象：一盒积木被分成一块一块。

branches.en: The counting branch: one part of a larger whole.
branches.cn: 计数分支：较大整体中的一个部分。

branches.en: The measuring branch: the standard chop of a quantity.
branches.cn: 度量分支：量被切成的标准份。

branches.en: The equipment branch: one machine or one part.
branches.cn: 设备分支：一台机器或一个部件。

branches.en: The staffing branch: people who act as one.
branches.cn: 人员分支：如同一个人行动的一群人。

branches.en: The property branch: a space that stands alone.
branches.cn: 房产分支：独立存在的一处空间。

intro.en: A Latin root for one plus a short noun ending is all this word contains.
intro.cn: 表示「一」的拉丁词根加一个短名词词尾，就是这个词的全部。

latinIntro.en: Unus is the source, and unitas gives the abstract noun unity.
latinIntro.cn: unus 是源头，unitas 生出抽象名词 unity。

items.exampleCN: unit 指一个被计数的部分。

definition_zh: 大学；综合性大学；大学校园
definition_en: a large school for higher education where students study for degrees and research is done
core_image: 一片古老的院落里，几栋教学楼、图书馆与宿舍围成一圈，学生抱着书穿过草坪
scene: 九月清晨，新生拖着箱子在门口停下，抬头看着门楣上刻着校名的石碑。She chose this university because of its astronomy department.
sceneCN: 这里 university 是「大学」（第 1 个义项：授予学位并进行研究的高等学校）；句意为她因为天文系而选择了这所大学。门口刻着校名的那片院落，就是这个词的样子。

pos.zh: 大学全体师生（集合用法）

derivatives.zh: 与本词同源，义为「普遍的；全体的」
与本词同源，义为「宇宙；全体」
由本词加 -arian 构成，义为「大学的；大学成员的」
由 inter- 加本词构成，义为「校际的」

senses.title: A place that grants degrees
senses.definition: an institution for higher education that awards degrees and carries out research
senses.definitionCN: 授予学位并进行研究的高等教育机构
senses.example: She teaches chemistry at a university in the north.
senses.exampleCN: 她在北方的一所大学教化学。
senses.why: Universitas first meant any whole body of people; the guild of teachers and students became this kind of school.
senses.whyCN: universitas 最初指任何一个人的整体；教师与学生的行会后来成了这种学校。

senses.title: The buildings and grounds
senses.definition: the buildings and grounds of such an institution, taken as a place
senses.definitionCN: 这样一所机构的建筑与场地，被当作一个地方
senses.example: The whole university was quiet during the summer holidays.
senses.exampleCN: 暑假期间整个校园都很安静。
senses.why: The abstract body of scholars became a physical place on a map.
senses.whyCN: 抽象的学者团体变成了地图上一个实在的地方。

senses.title: Its members together
senses.definition: all the students and teachers of the institution as a single community
senses.definitionCN: 把一所院校的学生与教师视为一个共同体
senses.example: The university voted to change the name of its main hall.
senses.exampleCN: 全校投票决定更改主楼的名字。
senses.why: The oldest sense survives: a university is still a group of people, not only walls.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的意义仍在：大学仍然是一群人，而不只是墙。

senses.title: The idea of higher learning
senses.definition: used generally of higher education as a stage of life or a system
senses.definitionCN: 泛指高等教育这一阶段或这一体系
senses.example: Going to university changes how a young person reads the world.
senses.exampleCN: 上大学会改变一个年轻人看世界的方式。
senses.why: British usage leaves out the article to name the stage itself rather than a building.
senses.whyCN: 英式用法省略冠词，指的是这个阶段本身而不是一栋建筑。

senses.title: Life as a school
senses.definition: in fixed phrases such as the university of life, experience treated as an education
senses.definitionCN: 用于 the university of life 等固定说法，把经历当作一种教育
senses.example: He never finished school, but the university of life taught him plenty.
senses.exampleCN: 他没有念完书，但社会这所大学教了他很多。
senses.why: The word becomes a metaphor: anything that teaches at length is granted its name.
senses.whyCN: 这个词成了比喻：凡是长期教人的东西都被赋予它的名字。

intro.en: University began as a Latin word for any whole body of people, and narrowed to the guild of scholars.
intro.cn: university 起初是拉丁语里指任何人的整体的词，后来收窄为学者的行会。

items.en: Universus meant turned into one, whole, and universitas meant the whole of a group.
items.cn: 拉丁语 universus 意为「合成一个的、整个的」，universitas 意为「一个团体的全体」。

items.en: In the Middle Ages universitas was used for any guild or corporation, including that of teachers and students.
items.cn: 中世纪时 universitas 可指任何行会或法人团体，也包括教师与学生的行会。

items.en: French université was applied specifically to the scholars' guild and the school it ran.
items.cn: 法语 université 专门用来指学者的行会及其所办的学校。

items.en: English took university in the fourteenth century for a school of higher learning with its own rules.
items.cn: 英语在十四世纪以 university 指有自身规章的高等学校。

items.en: The word spread with modern degree systems, and British usage dropped the article in go to university.
items.cn: 随着现代学位制度普及，这个词流传开来，英式用法在 go to university 中省略了冠词。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words on the same whole-body root; the near-meaning group gathers names for institutions of learning.
note.cn: 形近组收同一「整体」词根上的词；近义组收各类教育机构的名称。

entries.definition: The adjective for what applies to all.
All of space and matter; the root word of the family.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「宇宙」，是这一词族的根词。

entries.definition: The quality of holding for everyone.
The plural, used for several institutions.
Variety and difference; close in sound but built on another root.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「多样性」，读音相近但词根不同。

entries.definition: A smaller institution or a part of a university; often grants diplomas.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「学院」，规模较小或是大学的一部分。

entries.definition: A school for a special field, or a learned society.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「专科院校、学会」，多用于特定领域。

entries.definition: An organization for research or teaching in one field.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「学院、研究所」，多指某一领域的研究或教学机构。

entries.definition: A school for technical and applied subjects; in Britain often now a university.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「理工学院」，在英国如今多已成为大学。

entries.definition: A general word for any place of teaching, including primary ones.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「学校」，泛指任何教学场所，包括小学。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the old sense of a whole body of people and the phrases the word appears in.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子使用这个词「一群人的整体」的古老意义，以及它常见的搭配。

normal.en: Universitas meant any whole guild: a university is still a whole body of teachers and students.
normal.cn: universitas 指任何完整的行会：大学仍是教师与学生的整体。

normal.en: In British English people say go to university with no article.
normal.cn: 英式英语说 go to university，不加冠词。

normal.en: University student, university degree, university entrance: the word mainly works as an attributive.
normal.cn: university student、university degree、university entrance：这个词多作定语。

normal.en: The plural is universities, with the y turned to ie.
normal.cn: 复数是 universities，y 变为 ie。

normal.en: The university of life is a school without walls.
normal.cn: the university of life 是一所没有围墙的学校。

abstract.en: Picture a gate carved with a name: everyone who walks through becomes part of one body.
abstract.cn: 想象镌刻着校名的大门：走进来的人都成为一个整体的一部分。

abstract.en: The building and the community share one word, because the oldest sense is the people, not the stones.
abstract.cn: 建筑与共同体共用同一个词，因为最古老的意义是人而不是石头。

abstract.en: A university is a place that keeps knowledge alive by passing it on.
abstract.cn: 大学是一个靠传递而让知识活下来的地方。

examples.en: He studied law at a university in Beijing.
examples.cn: 他在北京的一所大学读法律。

examples.en: Most students live on campus during their first year at university.
examples.cn: 多数学生上大学的头一年住在校内。

examples.en: The university has three libraries and a small museum.
examples.cn: 这所大学有三个图书馆和一座小博物馆。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「优尼沃西提」——优尼沃西一提校名，人人都成了整体：大学

root: 源自拉丁语 universus「合成一个的、整个的」所生的 universitas「团体的全体」，中世纪指任何行会，包括师生行会；经古法语 université 进入英语，专指有自身规章的高等学校。

sensesIntro.en: Five senses of university all rest on one old idea: a whole body of people. That body became a school, then a place, then a stage of life, then a metaphor.
sensesIntro.cn: university 的五个义项都立在一个古老观念上：一群人的整体。这个整体成了学校，又成了地方、人生阶段，最后成了比喻。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a ring of old buildings around a lawn, with a carved name above the gate.
core.cn: 核心意象：一片古老建筑围着草坪，门楣上刻着校名。

branches.en: THE SCHOOL: the guild became an institution that grants degrees.
branches.cn: 学校线：行会变成了授予学位的机构。

branches.en: THE PLACE: the institution has walls, lawns and libraries.
branches.cn: 地点线：这所机构有墙、草坪与图书馆。

branches.en: THE MEMBERS: the oldest sense, all its students and teachers together.
branches.cn: 成员线：最古老的意义，全体师生合在一起。

branches.en: THE STAGE: going to university names a period of life.
branches.cn: 阶段线：上大学指的是人生的一段时期。

branches.en: THE METAPHOR: any long teacher is granted the name.
branches.cn: 比喻线：任何长期的教导者都被赋予这个名字。

intro.en: University is a Latin compound with the Latin suffix -tas, which becomes -ty in English.
intro.cn: university 是带拉丁语后缀 -tas 的复合词，该后缀在英语中变为 -ty。

latinIntro.en: Universus and universitas are both recorded, and the suffix -tas is the standard Latin way to make a noun of quality.
latinIntro.cn: universus 与 universitas 均有记录，-tas 是拉丁语构成性质名词的标准后缀。

items.example: The prefix gathers the group into one.
items.exampleCN: 这个前缀把人群收成一个。

items.example: The root gives the turning to one side.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根给出朝向一边转的意思。
它把 universitas 变成 university。

items.meaning: the whole of a body, a guild

items.example: The sense that produced the school.
items.exampleCN: 生出了这种学校的那个义项。

latinEntries.meaning: the whole of a body, a guild

definition_zh: 除非；如果不；除非在……情况下
definition_en: except if; used to say that something will happen only if another thing does not happen
core_image: 一个岔路口立着一块牌子：除非走左边，否则到不了目的地；右边是一条被挡住的路
scene: 教练在雨天早晨对队员说，只有雨停才训练，否则全体在馆里看录像。We will not play outside unless the rain stops by noon.
sceneCN: 这里 unless 是「除非」（第 1 个义项：表示只有在某条件不成立时才发生）；句意为除非中午前雨停，否则我们不在外面踢球。路口那块牌子划出的唯一通路，就是这个词的样子。

pos.zh: 除非；如果不（引导条件从句）
除……之外（少见，多见于书面）
除非在……的情况下（与 not 连用表双重否定）

collocations.zh: 除非……否则什么也不会发生

derivatives.zh: 由本词加 -ed 构成，义为「带 unless 从句的」
由古英语 þy læs þe 缩合而成，义为「以免」，是 unless 的老近亲
与本词同源，义为「较少的」，构成 unless 的后半

senses.title: Except if
senses.definition: except if; a condition that alone can change the result
senses.definitionCN: 「除非」；唯一能够改变结果的那个条件
senses.example: You cannot enter unless you show your ticket.
senses.exampleCN: 除非出示门票，否则你不能进场。
senses.why: Unless is a compressed on less: the case you name is the single exception to the statement.
senses.whyCN: unless 是 on less 的压缩：你提出的那种情形是对这句话的唯一例外。

senses.title: Only in that case
senses.definition: used after a negative or in a question to mean only if
senses.definitionCN: 用于否定句或疑问句之后，意为「只有在……才」
senses.example: I will not agree unless the whole plan is explained first.
senses.exampleCN: 除非先把整个计划解释清楚，否则我不会同意。
senses.why: With not in front, the exception becomes the one door left open.
senses.whyCN: 前面加了 not，这个例外就成了唯一还开着的门。

senses.title: Except for
senses.definition: in older or formal prose, except for a thing just mentioned
senses.definitionCN: 在较早或正式的书面语中，指「除了刚提到的某物」
senses.example: Nothing was left of the house unless the stone steps.
senses.exampleCN: 除了那几级石阶，这座房子什么也没有剩下。
senses.why: The very old prepositional use keeps the plain sense of less as leaving something out.
senses.whyCN: 很古老的介词用法保留着 less「除去」的朴素含义。

senses.title: In fixed legal phrases
senses.definition: in clauses such as unless otherwise stated, the rule applies except where noted
senses.definitionCN: 在 unless otherwise stated 一类条款中，表示除注明处之外规则一律适用
senses.example: The fee is paid yearly unless otherwise agreed in writing.
senses.exampleCN: 除非另有书面约定，费用按年支付。
senses.why: Contracts need a single word for the written exception, and this is that word.
senses.whyCN: 合同需要一个词专门表示书面的例外，用的就是这个词。

senses.title: Doubled for emphasis
senses.definition: in the phrase unless and until, meaning not before at the earliest
senses.definitionCN: 在 unless and until 这一说法中，意为「最早也要到……才行」
senses.example: The office stays closed unless and until the roof is repaired.
senses.exampleCN: 除非并且直到屋顶修好，办公室才会重新开放。
senses.why: Two limiters side by side make the condition sound impossible to soften.
senses.whyCN: 两个限定词并排，让这个条件听起来无从通融。

intro.en: Unless is a worn-down phrase rather than a word built from parts: on less, meaning on a lesser condition.
intro.cn: unless 不是由词缀构成，而是一个磨短了的短语：on less，意为「在较小的条件下」。

items.en: The preposition on and the comparative lǣssa, less, stood side by side as on lǣssan, on a lesser condition.
items.cn: 介词 on 与比较级 lǣssa（较少）并列为 on lǣssan，意为「在较小的条件下」。

items.en: The phrase shrank to on lesse and then to unless, losing the space and then the o.
items.cn: 这个短语缩为 on lesse，再缩为 unless，先丢了空格，又丢了 o。

items.en: By the fourteenth century unless was used as a conjunction before a clause.
items.cn: 到十四世纪，unless 已用作引导从句的连词。

items.en: Lest, from a parallel phrase, kept the older meaning of avoiding something, and the two words divided the work.
items.cn: 由类似短语来的 lest 保留了「以免」的旧义，两个词于是各司其职。

items.en: Modern contracts fixed unless otherwise stated as a standard clause formula.
items.cn: 现代合同把 unless otherwise stated 固化为标准条款用语。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers negatives and near forms in un- or less; the near-meaning group gathers conjunctions of condition that differ in strength.
note.cn: 形近组收以 un- 或 less 构成的否定词与近形词；近义组收表示条件的连词，力度不同。

entries.definition: Up to the time that; it names a moment, not a condition.
entries.definitionCN: 连词，义为「直到」，指时间点而非条件。

entries.definition: About, regarding; close in sound to the old prepositional use only.
For fear that; the older partner of unless.
entries.definitionCN: 连词，义为「以免」，是 unless 较早的搭档词。

entries.definition: In spite of that; it contains less but means despite, not except.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「然而、不过」，含 less 但意为转折而非例外。

entries.definition: Nevertheless; it contains less but means in spite of that.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「尽管如此」，含 less 但意义不同。

entries.definition: The plain conditional with a negative; unless is its compressed form.
entries.definitionCN: 短语，义为「如果不」，unless 是其压缩形式。

entries.definition: The full phrase behind unless, still used in careful speech.
entries.definitionCN: 短语，义为「除非」，是 unless 的完整说法。

entries.definition: Only on the condition that; it states the condition positively.
entries.definitionCN: 连词短语，义为「只要」，从正面提出条件。

entries.definition: If not, or in other circumstances; often pairs with unless in clauses.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「否则」，常与 unless 在条款中配合使用。

entries.definition: As a precaution because something might happen; not the same as unless.
entries.definitionCN: 连词短语，义为「以防」，与 unless 不同。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the worn-down on less behind the word and the clauses it appears in.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子使用这个词背后磨短的 on less，以及它常出现的从句。

normal.en: Unless is on less in disguise: the one case on a lesser footing, the exception.
normal.cn: unless 是 on less 的变形：那个处于次要地位的唯一情形，就是例外。

normal.en: Unless you show your ticket, you cannot enter: the exception is the only open door.
normal.cn: unless you show your ticket 意为除非出示门票；例外就是唯一开着的门。

normal.en: Unless otherwise stated is the standard formula in contracts.
normal.cn: unless otherwise stated 是合同里的标准说法。

normal.en: Do not confuse unless with until: one is a condition, the other a time.
normal.cn: 不要把 unless 与 until 混用：一个是条件，一个是时间。

normal.en: Lest and unless once did the same work.
normal.cn: lest 与 unless 曾做同一份工作。

abstract.en: Picture a road with a single gate: unless is the gate, and nothing else lets you through.
abstract.cn: 想象一条只有一道门的路：unless 就是那道门，别的都通不过。

abstract.en: The word thinks in negatives: it names the only thing that can stop the statement from being true.
abstract.cn: 这个词用否定来思考：它指出唯一能让这句话不成立的事。

abstract.en: Every rule has a unless hidden in it, which is why contracts love the word.
abstract.cn: 每条规则里都藏着一个 unless，所以合同喜欢这个词。

examples.en: Do not call me unless it is urgent.
examples.cn: 除非有急事，否则别打电话给我。

examples.en: The meeting will go ahead unless the storm gets worse.
examples.cn: 除非暴风雨加剧，会议照常举行。

examples.en: Unless otherwise stated, all prices include tax.
examples.cn: 除非另有说明，所有价格均含税。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「安的莱斯」——安说：除非莱斯先来，否则不开始：除非

root: 由中古英语短语 on lesse（在较小的条件下）缩合而成，源自 on 与比较级 lǣssa（较少）；十四世纪起作连词，与 lest 分工，现代又在合同里固定为 except 条件的标准说法。

sensesIntro.en: Five senses of unless all name the one exception: the only case where the statement fails, whether spoken as a condition, a negative clause, an old preposition, a contract formula, or a doubled limiter.
sensesIntro.cn: unless 的五个义项都指那唯一的例外：这句话唯一不成立的情形，表现为条件、否定从句、古老介词、合同套语或叠用的限定。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a single open gate on an otherwise blocked road.
core.cn: 核心意象：一条被挡住的路上一道唯一开着的门。

branches.en: THE EXCEPTION: the named case alone changes what happens.
branches.cn: 例外线：只有被点出的那种情形改变结果。

branches.en: THE NEGATIVE: after not, the exception becomes the only way in.
branches.cn: 否定线：在 not 之后，例外成了唯一的进路。

branches.en: THE OLD PREPOSITION: except for a thing, in older prose.
branches.cn: 旧介词线：在较早的书面语中表示「除某物之外」。

branches.en: THE CONTRACT: written rules need a word for the noted exception.
branches.cn: 合同线：书面规则需要一个词表示注明的例外。

branches.en: THE DOUBLE LIMIT: unless and until leaves no room to soften.
branches.cn: 双限线：unless and until 不给任何通融余地。

intro.en: This word has no affixes at all: it is a phrase worn down to six letters.
intro.cn: 这个词完全没有词缀：它是一个被磨短到六个字母的短语。

latinIntro.en: Nothing here is Latin; under this word sit the preposition on and an old comparative meaning less.
latinIntro.cn: 这里没有拉丁成分；这个词底下是介词 on 与一个意为「较少」的古老比较级。

items.example: It survives only as the hidden first sound.
items.exampleCN: 它只作为隐藏的第一个音留存。

items.example: It is the modern shape of lǣssa.
items.exampleCN: 它是 lǣssa 的现代形式。

items.example: The comparative inside the old phrase.
items.exampleCN: 旧短语里的那个比较级。

items.example: A parallel contraction from þy læs þe.
items.exampleCN: 由 þy læs þe 并行的缩合词。

items.example: A look-alike that keeps less visible.
items.exampleCN: 一个把 less 留在表面的形近词。

items.example: The final form of on lesse.
Two limiters side by side in legal English.
items.exampleCN: 法律英语中并排使用的两个限定词。

definition_zh: 直到；到……为止；直到……才；（否定句）直到……才
definition_en: up to the time when something happens or ends
core_image: 走廊尽头的灯一直亮着，亮到门开为止
scene: 母亲坐在客厅没关灯，说要等孩子进门她才去睡。She waited in the hall until the last bus arrived.
sceneCN: 这里 until 是「直到……为止」（第 1 个义项：动作持续到某时）；句意为她在门厅一直等到末班车到达。走廊的灯亮到门开为止的画面，正是这个词的核心。

derivatives.zh: 同义的较短形式，义为「直到」，口语中更常用
形近但不同源，义为「不合时宜的」（只是拼写相近，词源不同）

senses.title: Action that continues up to a point in time
senses.definition: used to say that an action goes on and stops at a certain time
senses.definitionCN: 表示动作持续进行，到某一时间停止
senses.example: The shop stays open until nine.
senses.exampleCN: 这家店开到九点。
senses.why: The word marks the end point of a stretch of time, and the thing before that point simply keeps going.
senses.whyCN: 这个词标出一段时间的终点，在此之前的事情就一直在持续。

senses.title: Not before a certain time
senses.definition: used with a negative or in a question to mean not happening before a time
senses.definitionCN: 与否定或疑问连用，表示在某一时间之前没有发生
senses.example: He did not answer until the third knock.
senses.exampleCN: 直到敲第三下他才应门。
senses.why: If a line marks where something stops, then nothing has happened on the near side of it; this is the negative reading.
senses.whyCN: 既然一条线标出某事停止的地方，那么线这一侧就还什么都没发生，这正是否定用法。

senses.title: A limit set on a rule
senses.definition: used of rules and notices that last up to a stated point
senses.definitionCN: 用于规定或通告，表示有效到某一时点
senses.example: The office is closed until Monday.
senses.exampleCN: 办公室关到星期一。
senses.why: A notice needs an end point, and the word supplies exactly the point where the rule stops.
senses.whyCN: 通告需要一个终点，这个词提供的正是规定停止的那一点。

senses.title: A change that finally comes
senses.definition: used when a state lasts and then finally gives way
senses.definitionCN: 表示某种状态一直持续，最后才改变
senses.example: The noise went on until someone complained.
senses.exampleCN: 吵闹一直继续，直到有人投诉才停。
senses.why: When a stretch is long, the moment it ends is also the moment something turns, so the word gathers a sense of turning.
senses.whyCN: 当这一段很长时，它结束的那一刻也正是事情转折的一刻，于是这个词带上了转折意味。

senses.title: Until then in narrative
senses.definition: used in stories for the time before an event happens
senses.definitionCN: 在叙述中指某事发生之前的那段时间
senses.example: Until that night, nobody in the village locked a door.
senses.exampleCN: 在那晚之前，村里没人锁门。
senses.why: In a story the same end point can be read backwards, naming all the time before the event arrives.
senses.whyCN: 在故事里，同一个终点也可以反着读，指事件到来之前的整段时间。

intro.en: An old compound preposition whose first part survives in our northern word for the same thing.
intro.cn: 一个古老的复合介词，其前一部分仍保存在同义的北方说法里。

items.en: The form und means up to, and the older Scandinavian words spread it into English.
items.cn: und 意为「直到」，更早的斯堪的纳维亚语形式把它带进英语。

items.en: Till was already used for up to a time, and it is not a shortened form of until.
items.cn: till 早已表示「直到」，它并不是 until 的缩写。

items.en: Untill appears as a reinforced till, with un- here meaning up to rather than not.
items.cn: untill 作为加强形式的 till 出现，此处 un- 意为「直到」，并非否定。

items.en: Until and till are used side by side, until being more formal in writing.
items.cn: until 与 till 并行使用，写作中 until 更正式。

items.en: Not until opens a clause and forces the main verb to come late, a favourite of formal prose.
items.cn: not until 引导从句并使主动词后置，是正式文章偏爱的结构。

note.en: The look-alike group collects time prepositions and similar spellings, while the near-meaning group compares end points.
note.cn: 形近组收集时间介词与相近拼写，近义组比较表示终点的时间词。

entries.definition: up to a time
happening at the wrong moment
entries.definitionCN: 不合时宜的（只是拼写相近，词源不同）

entries.definition: ill
entries.definitionCN: 身体不适的（只是拼写相近，词源不同）

entries.definition: except if
entries.definitionCN: 除非（只是拼写相近，词源不同）

entries.definition: not later than a time
earlier than a time
throughout a period
from a time in the past until now

normalIntro.en: A short, very old time word whose shape looks like a negative but is not one.
normalIntro.cn: 一个简短而古老的表示时间的词，它的样子像否定，其实不是。

normal.en: Until and till are equally old; neither is a clipping of the other.
normal.cn: until 与 till 一样古老，谁也不是谁截出来的。

normal.en: Not until with an inverted main clause is the formal pattern.
normal.cn: not until 加倒装主句是正式模式。

normal.en: From morning until night shows the stretch of time clearly.
normal.cn: from morning until night 清楚显示了时间的段距。

normal.en: Until further notice is the fixed phrase in notices.
normal.cn: until further notice 是通告里的固定说法。

normal.en: The un- here means up to, unlike un- in unhappy.
normal.cn: 此处的 un- 意为「直到」，不同于 unhappy 中的 un-。

abstract.en: Watch a hallway light burn until a door opens.
abstract.cn: 想象走廊的灯一直亮着，直到门打开。

abstract.en: Count three knocks before the chain is lifted.
abstract.cn: 数到第三下敲门声，链子才被摘下。

abstract.en: See a line drawn on a road, and a car stopping at it.
abstract.cn: 看路面上画着一条线，一辆车停在线上。

examples.en: We waited at the gate until the lights went out.
examples.cn: 我们在门口一直等到灯灭。

examples.en: She did not speak until the whole room was quiet.
examples.cn: 直到整个房间安静下来，她才开口。

examples.en: The road will stay closed until the bridge is repaired.
examples.cn: 这条路将封闭到桥梁修好为止。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「俺踢了」——等得实在不耐烦，俺踢了踢门框，一直踢到门开为止。

root: 中古英语 untill，由上古北欧语 und（直到）与 till（到……为止）结合而成；till 本身并非 until 的缩略，二者同义并行

sensesIntro.en: One function, marking the end of a stretch of time, yields the durative sense and the negative sense.
sensesIntro.cn: 一个功能「标出一段时间的终点」，生出持续义与否定义两路。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a bright line drawn on a road.
core.cn: 核心意象：路面上一条亮着的线。

branches.en: The duration branch: something goes on all the way there.
branches.cn: 持续分支：某事一路持续到那一点。

branches.en: The negative branch: nothing happens on the near side.
branches.cn: 否定分支：线这一侧什么都没发生。

branches.en: The notice branch: rules that last to a stated point.
branches.cn: 通告分支：规定有效到某个时点。

branches.en: The turning branch: a long state at last gives way.
branches.cn: 转折分支：长久的状态终于让位。

branches.en: The narrative branch: the stretch before an event.
branches.cn: 叙述分支：事件之前的那段时光。

intro.en: A small function word made of two old time markers fused together.
intro.cn: 一个由两个古老时间标记融合而成的小功能词。

latinIntro.en: The word is Germanic; the Latin adverb for up to this point is tenus, used with a genitive.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词属日耳曼语；拉丁语中表示「到此为止」的副词是 tenus，与属格连用。

items.example: Until keeps the older sense of un as up to.
items.exampleCN: until 保留了 un 意为「直到」的古义。

items.example: Not until noon did it stop raining.
The office is closed until further notice.
items.exampleCN: 办公室关闭，直到另行通知。

items.example: Up until last week he was here.
items.exampleCN: 一直到上周他都在这里。

definition_zh: 向上；起来；在上面；（数量）上升；（时间）到；完成；沿……而上
definition_en: towards a higher place, position, or level, or into an active or finished state
core_image: 一只手从低处把东西往上托
scene: 工地上吊绳绷紧，一捆钢筋从坑底慢慢露出地面。The load came up out of the pit slowly.
sceneCN: 这里 up 是「向上」（第 1 个义项：由低处升高处）；句意为那捆货从坑底慢慢升上来。一只手从低处把东西往上托，正是这个词的核心。

pos.zh: 向上的；已完成的；醒着的

derivatives.zh: 由 up 加比较级词尾构成，义为「上部的；较高的」
由 up 加 -ward 构成，义为「向上的；朝上」
由 up 与 stairs 复合，义为「在楼上；上楼」
由 up 与 set 复合，原义「打翻」，引申为「使心烦」

senses.title: Towards a higher place
senses.definition: towards a higher place or position
senses.definitionCN: 朝更高的地方或位置
senses.example: She looked up at the clock and frowned.
senses.exampleCN: 她抬头看了看钟，皱起眉头。
senses.why: The word began as a Germanic adverb of upward motion, and that physical direction is still its centre.
senses.whyCN: 这个词起初是日耳曼语中表示向上运动的副词，这一物理方向至今仍是它的中心。

senses.title: Into a standing or active state
senses.definition: into a standing, awake, or working state
senses.definitionCN: 进入站起、醒着或运转的状态
senses.example: He got up as soon as the bell rang.
senses.exampleCN: 铃声一响他就站了起来。
senses.why: Rising from the ground is also rising into activity, so standing up and waking up share one word.
senses.whyCN: 从地面升起也就是进入活动状态，因此「站起来」与「醒来」共用一个词。

senses.title: Along a road or a slope
senses.definition: used as a preposition for movement along or higher on something
senses.definitionCN: 作介词，表示沿某物前行或在其较高处
senses.example: They walked up the hill without speaking.
senses.exampleCN: 他们一言不发地走上山坡。
senses.why: Walking up a slope is the same upward motion, so the adverb easily becomes a preposition of route.
senses.whyCN: 沿坡行走还是同一个向上的动作，因此这个副词很容易转为表示路径的介词。

senses.title: Increasing in number or level
senses.definition: used of prices, numbers, or levels that rise
senses.definitionCN: 用于价格、数字或水平的升高
senses.example: Sales went up sharply in the last quarter.
senses.exampleCN: 上季度销量急剧上升。
senses.why: Numbers move in space in everyday speech, so a rising figure is simply a thing that goes up.
senses.whyCN: 日常说法里数字也在空间中移动，于是数值上升就是一样东西「往上去了」。

senses.title: Finished or out of time
senses.definition: used when a period or supply has come to its end
senses.definitionCN: 表示一段时间或供给已经到尽头
senses.example: Time is up, so put your pens down.
senses.exampleCN: 时间到了，把笔放下吧。
senses.why: A measure filled to the top can rise no further, and that image gives the sense of finished.
senses.whyCN: 容器装到顶就再升不上去了，这个意象生出「结束、用完」的意思。

senses.title: As far as a stated number
senses.definition: used with to for the greatest number reached
senses.definitionCN: 与 to 连用，表示所达到的最大数目
senses.example: The hall holds up to three hundred people.
senses.exampleCN: 这个大厅最多能容纳三百人。
senses.why: If up means reaching a point higher on a scale, then up to names the point where a number stops.
senses.whyCN: 既然 up 指沿某一刻度到达更高处，那么 up to 就指出数字停下的那一点。

intro.en: One of the oldest words in English, an adverb of place before it was anything else.
intro.cn: 英语中最古老的词之一，它首先是表示方位的副词。

items.en: The reconstructed form upp means up, and it has relatives in Dutch and German.
items.cn: 重构形式 upp 意为「向上」，在荷兰语和德语中都有同源词。

items.en: The adverb up is recorded early, with the comparative upper forming alongside it.
items.cn: 副词 up 很早就有记录，比较级 upper 也随之形成。

items.en: It is used with verbs of motion, as in standan up, to stand up.
items.cn: 它常与运动动词连用，如 standan up（站起来）。

items.en: Everyday phrases such as get up and up to now fix the word as a particle.
items.cn: get up、up to now 这类日常短语把它固定为小品词。

items.en: The sense of finished or used up appears in time is up and the gas is up.
items.cn: 「结束、用完」的含义出现在 time is up 与 the gas is up 这类说法里。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers compounds and derivatives of up, while the near-meaning group compares direction and degree words.
note.cn: 形近组汇集 up 的复合词与派生词，近义组比较方向与程度词。

entries.definition: higher of two things
moving towards a higher point
on or to a higher floor
on top of
in a higher position
across or higher than
towards a lower place
high in the air

normalIntro.en: A tiny word with a very long history, best learned through its verb phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 一个历史极悠久的小词，最好的记法是通过它与动词组成的短语。

normal.en: Learn up through verbs: get up, look up, stand up, give up.
normal.cn: 通过动词记：get up、look up、stand up、give up。

normal.en: Up plus to means as far as, either in number or in time.
normal.cn: up 加 to 意为「达到」，可用于数目或时间。

normal.en: Upper is the older comparative of up, not a separate root.
normal.cn: upper 是 up 较古老的比较级，并非另一个词根。

normal.en: Up and down together make the picture of repeated movement.
normal.cn: up and down 连用画出反复移动的画面。

normal.en: Time is up uses up as finished, not as direction.
normal.cn: time is up 里的 up 表示「结束」，不是方向。

abstract.en: Watch a hand lift something out of a pit.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手把东西从坑里托出来。

abstract.en: Feel a rope tighten and a bucket rise.
abstract.cn: 体会绳子绷紧、桶子升起。

abstract.en: See a hand switch a lamp on.
abstract.cn: 看一只手把灯打开。

examples.en: The children ran up the hill to see the sea.
examples.cn: 孩子们跑上山去看海。

examples.en: Prices went up again in the spring.
examples.cn: 价格在春天又一次上涨。

examples.en: Time is up, and the exam papers must be handed in.
examples.cn: 时间到了，试卷必须交上来。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「阿普」——搬东西时喊着阿普阿普，众人一起用力把重物往上抬。

root: 古英语 up（副词），源自日耳曼语重构形式 upp，与荷兰语 op、德语 auf 同源，本义「向上」

sensesIntro.en: One upward motion supplies direction, then standing, then rising levels, finally finishing and reaching a limit.
sensesIntro.cn: 一个向上的动作先给方向，再给站立，再给上升，最后给结束与达到极限。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand lifting something from below.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手从下面把东西抬起。

branches.en: The direction branch: eyes and objects go higher.
branches.cn: 方向分支：视线与物件往高处去。

branches.en: The state branch: up means awake, standing, working.
branches.cn: 状态分支：up 指醒着、站着、运转着。

branches.en: The preposition branch: along or higher on a road.
branches.cn: 介词分支：沿路而行或位于高处。

branches.en: The figure branch: numbers that keep climbing.
branches.cn: 数字分支：一路往上爬的数值。

branches.en: The limit branch: used up, and as far as a number.
branches.cn: 极限分支：用完了，以及达到某个数目。

intro.en: A bare Germanic adverb that now works as particle, preposition, adjective, and noun.
intro.cn: 一个光秃秃的日耳曼语副词，如今可作小品词、介词、形容词与名词。

latinIntro.en: Latin expresses the same direction with sursum, upward, and the prefix super-.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语用 sursum（向上）与前缀 super- 表达同一方向。

items.meaning: to raise to a better level

definition_zh: 在……之上；一……就；在……之后立即；依据；关于
definition_en: on, or immediately after something happens, or used to introduce the basis of something
core_image: 手按下去，正好落在桌面上
scene: 老人把手掌贴在旧相册的封面上，久久没有说话。He laid his hand upon the cover and was silent for a while.
sceneCN: 这里 upon 是「在……之上」（第 1 个义项：接触并覆在某物上）；句意为他把手放在封面上，沉默了好一会儿。手掌落上桌面的画面，正是这个词的核心。

derivatives.zh: 同义而更常用的形式，义为「在……上」
由 there 与 upon 复合，义为「随即；因此」
由 where 与 upon 复合，义为「于是；随即」

senses.title: Resting on a surface
senses.definition: in contact with the top of something
senses.definitionCN: 与某个物体的上表面接触
senses.example: He set the cup upon the table.
senses.exampleCN: 他把杯子放在桌面上。
senses.why: The word is a strengthened form of on, and the physical contact with a surface is its first sense.
senses.whyCN: 这个词是 on 的加强形式，与表面的实物接触是它的第一层意思。

senses.title: Immediately after something happens
senses.definition: at the moment of, or right after, an event
senses.definitionCN: 在某个事件发生之时或紧接其后
senses.example: Upon hearing the news, she dropped the phone.
senses.exampleCN: 一听到消息，她就把电话掉了。
senses.why: Whatever lies upon something arrives touching it at once, and this contact becomes immediate succession.
senses.whyCN: 放在某物之上的东西会立刻贴上它，这种接触便化为「紧接而来」。

senses.title: Used for the basis of a decision
senses.definition: used to introduce what a decision or belief rests on
senses.definitionCN: 用于引出决定或信念所依托之物
senses.example: The judge acted upon the evidence in the file.
senses.exampleCN: 法官依据卷宗里的证据行事。
senses.why: A decision resting on evidence is like a weight resting on a table, so the word marks the ground beneath it.
senses.whyCN: 决定依托证据，就像重物托在桌面上，于是这个词用来标出底下的那块地面。

senses.title: Used in formal statements of obligation
senses.definition: used to name who carries a duty or a blame
senses.definitionCN: 用于指明义务或过失由谁承担
senses.example: The duty fell upon the youngest son.
senses.exampleCN: 这份责任落在了最小的儿子身上。
senses.why: A duty set on a person is literally a load placed on a surface, and the image transfers to responsibility.
senses.whyCN: 落在某人身上的义务，字面上就是压在某个表面上的一份重量，于是这个画面转成了责任。

senses.title: Frozen in story openings
senses.definition: kept in the fixed phrase that begins folk tales
senses.definitionCN: 保留在童话开头固定说法里
senses.example: Once upon a time a shop stood on this corner.
senses.exampleCN: 从前这个街角开着一家店。
senses.why: The tale's first scene is placed upon a time, and the phrase has not changed for centuries.
senses.whyCN: 故事的第一个场景被「搁在」一段时间上，这个说法几百年都没变。

intro.en: Two old prepositions, one piled on the other for emphasis.
intro.cn: 两个古老的介词，一个叠在另一个之上以加强语气。

items.en: On is ancient, and up is an old adverb of motion upward.
items.cn: on 十分古老，up 则是表示向上运动的古副词。

items.en: The compound uppon puts the two together with the sense of resting on top of.
items.cn: 复合形式 uppon 把两者合起来，意为「覆于其上」。

items.en: Upon competes with on and keeps a more formal and literary tone.
items.cn: upon 与 on 并用，但保留了更正式、更书卷的语气。

items.en: Upon fixes itself in set phrases such as once upon a time and upon request.
items.cn: upon 固定在 once upon a time、upon request 等熟语里。

items.en: The sense of immediately after develops in formal writing.
items.cn: 「紧接其后」的含义在正式书面语中发展出来。

note.en: The look-alike group shows other up- words that are not related, while the near-meaning group compares prepositions of position and time.
note.cn: 形近组列出与 up 相关但无词源关联的其他词，近义组比较位置与时间介词。

entries.definitionCN: 上部的（只是拼写相近，词源不同）

entries.definition: to support, as a court does
entries.definitionCN: 维护；支持（只是拼写相近，词源不同）

normalIntro.en: A piled-up preposition, formal in tone, alive mostly in fixed phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 一个叠加而成的介词，语气正式，主要活在固定短语里。

normal.en: Think of upon as on with an extra push of up.
normal.cn: 把 upon 想成 on 加上 up 的一推。

normal.en: Once upon a time is the phrase every learner already knows.
normal.cn: once upon a time 是学习者早已会说的短语。

normal.en: Upon request and upon arrival show the formal register.
normal.cn: upon request 与 upon arrival 显示出正式语气。

normal.en: Rely upon and depend upon are equally correct with on.
normal.cn: rely upon、depend upon 与用 on 一样正确。

normal.en: Upon hearing is the common frame for immediately after.
normal.cn: upon hearing 是表示「一听到就」的常见框架。

abstract.en: Press a palm flat on a book cover.
abstract.cn: 把掌心平平按在书封上。

abstract.en: See one stone laid exactly on another.
abstract.cn: 看一块石头正好压在另一块上。

abstract.en: Hear a door open the instant a knock ends.
abstract.cn: 听敲门声一停，门就开了。

examples.en: She placed the letter upon the desk and turned away.
examples.cn: 她把信放在桌上，转身走了。

examples.en: Upon arriving at the station, he called his mother.
examples.cn: 一到车站，他就给母亲打了电话。

examples.en: The committee decided upon the plan after a long debate.
examples.cn: 经过长时间辩论，委员会就这个方案作出了决定。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「额碰」——低头太急，额碰在桌沿上，正好碰在桌面这个「之上」的位置。

root: 古英语复合形式 uppon，由 up（向上）与 on（在……上）合并而成，本义「覆于其上」，与 on 同源同义而语气更正式

sensesIntro.en: Contact with a surface gives rest, then immediate succession, then grounds, then duty, then a story opening.
sensesIntro.cn: 与表面的接触先给「搁置」，再给「紧接」，再给依据、义务，最后给故事开头。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a palm pressed flat on a surface.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手掌平压在表面上。

branches.en: The surface branch: a thing set down and in contact.
branches.cn: 表面分支：放下去并贴着的东西。

branches.en: The time branch: contact becomes immediate succession.
branches.cn: 时间分支：接触变成紧接其后。

branches.en: The ground branch: what a decision stands on.
branches.cn: 根据分支：决定所踩的地面。

branches.en: The duty branch: blame resting on someone.
branches.cn: 义务分支：落在某人身上的责任。

branches.en: The story branch: the fixed opening of a tale.
branches.cn: 故事分支：故事固定的开头。

intro.en: A compound preposition whose two parts are both very old and still in daily use.
intro.cn: 一个复合介词，两个部分都非常古老，且今天仍在使用。

latinIntro.en: Latin uses super for on top of and in plus a noun for the time sense.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语用 super 表示「在……之上」，时间义则用 in 加名词。

items.example: The book is on the desk.
Upon arrival, report to the desk.
Once upon a time a girl lived here.
items.exampleCN: 从前有个姑娘住在这里。

items.example: We rely upon the river for water.

definition_zh: 打翻；弄翻；使心烦；使不适；（比赛）意外击败；心烦的；不快的
definition_en: to knock something over, to make someone unhappy, or to beat a stronger opponent unexpectedly
core_image: 手肘一碰，杯子朝桌上倒下去
scene: 婚礼前夜，有人把饮料碰洒在新娘的礼服上，所有人都慌了。The news upset her so much that she could not sleep.
sceneCN: 这里 upset 是「使心烦」（第 2 个义项：让人心里翻腾不快）；句意为这个消息让她心烦得整夜没睡。手肘碰倒杯子的画面，正是这个词的核心。

derivatives.zh: 来自 distress 的过去分词，义为「痛苦的；忧虑的」
由 upset 加 -ing 构成，义为「令人不安的」

senses.title: To knock something over
senses.definition: to make a container or object fall over
senses.definitionCN: 使容器或物体倒下
senses.example: She upset the glass with her elbow.
senses.exampleCN: 她的手肘把杯子碰倒了。
senses.why: The word is up plus set: to set something up, or rather out of its place, until it falls over.
senses.whyCN: 这个词是 up 加 set：把东西从原位「顶起来」，直到翻倒。

senses.title: To make someone unhappy
senses.definition: to make a person worried, hurt, or unhappy
senses.definitionCN: 使人担忧、难受或不快
senses.example: The letter upset him more than he showed.
senses.exampleCN: 那封信让他心烦，比他表现出来的还要厉害。
senses.why: When a mind is knocked off balance like a cup, the person is upset, and the object becomes the feeling.
senses.whyCN: 当心意像杯子一样被弄得失去平衡，人就成了 upset，物象便化为情绪。

senses.title: To disturb a plan or a system
senses.definition: to disturb an arrangement or a process
senses.definitionCN: 扰乱某个安排或进程
senses.example: The storm upset the whole timetable.
senses.exampleCN: 暴风雨打乱了整个时刻表。
senses.why: A plan laid out like objects on a table can be knocked over too, and then nothing stays in place.
senses.whyCN: 摆好的计划就像桌上的物件，也可能被撞翻，之后便没有一样东西待在原位。

senses.title: To beat a stronger opponent
senses.definition: to defeat a team or player expected to win
senses.definitionCN: 击败被判为会赢的一方
senses.example: The visitors upset the champions in the final minute.
senses.exampleCN: 客队在最后一分钟爆冷赢下卫冕冠军。
senses.why: The result turns the table over: the side everyone placed first falls out of its place.
senses.whyCN: 这个结果把牌桌翻了过来：大家早先摆好的那一方从位子上跌落。

senses.title: A disturbed stomach
senses.definition: used of a stomach that feels unsettled
senses.definitionCN: 形容肚子不舒服、翻搅
senses.example: Too much fried food gives him an upset stomach.
senses.exampleCN: 油炸吃得太多，他就肠胃不适。
senses.why: Inside the body the same upsetting happens, and the stomach is described as turned over.
senses.whyCN: 身体内部也发生同样的翻搅，于是肠胃被说成「倒了」。

senses.title: A surprising defeat
senses.definition: a result in which the expected winner loses
senses.definitionCN: 本该获胜的一方却输了的结果
senses.example: The final was a real upset for the home crowd.
senses.exampleCN: 决赛对主场观众来说是个大冷门。
senses.why: The noun keeps the picture of a table turned over, now applied to an expected result.
senses.whyCN: 名词保留了桌面被翻掉的画面，只是这一次用在了原本意料之中的结果上。

intro.en: A two-part compound of native words whose first sense is physical and whose later senses are emotional.
intro.cn: 一个由本土词构成的两部分复合词，最初的意思是身体的，后来的意思是情绪的。

items.en: Up is an old adverb, and settan meant to place or put.
items.cn: up 是古副词，settan 意为「放置」。

items.en: Upsetten means to set up or to overturn, and the two meanings coexist.
items.cn: upsetten 兼有「竖起」与「推翻」两种意思，二者并存。

items.en: The sense of overturning settles first in the physical world of cups and carts.
items.cn: 「打翻」的意思先固定下来，用于杯子和推车这类实物。

items.en: By the eighteenth century upset describes a disturbed mind and a disturbed stomach.
items.cn: 到十八世纪，upset 已用于形容被搅乱的心情与肠胃。

items.en: The sports sense of an unexpected defeat appears in the nineteenth century.
items.cn: 「爆冷」这一体育含义在十九世纪出现。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers up-set compounds and similar forms, while the near-meaning group collects words for troubling someone.
note.cn: 形近组汇集 up 与 set 组成的复合词及相近形式，近义组汇集表示使人难过的词。

normalIntro.en: A compound image that moves by easy steps from a falling cup to a troubled mind.
normalIntro.cn: 一个复合意象，从翻倒的杯子很自然地过渡到被搅乱的心。

normal.en: Up plus set: set it up so it tips over.
normal.cn: up 加 set：把东西顶起来直到翻倒。

normal.en: Be upset about something is the emotional frame learners need most.
normal.cn: be upset about 是学习者最需要的情绪框架。

normal.en: Upset is irregular: upset, upset, upset.
normal.cn: upset 的三态同形：upset、upset、upset。

normal.en: An upset stomach and a major upset show the two noun senses.
normal.cn: an upset stomach 与 a major upset 展示了两种名词义。

normal.en: Upsetting is the adjective for what causes the feeling.
normal.cn: upsetting 是表示「令人心烦」的形容词。

abstract.en: Nudge a cup with your elbow and watch it tip.
abstract.cn: 用手肘碰一下杯子，看它倒下。

abstract.en: See a chess board pushed an inch off the table.
abstract.cn: 看见棋盘被推离桌沿一点点。

abstract.en: Feel a plan come apart in the space of one phone call.
abstract.cn: 体会一个计划在一通电话里散架。

examples.en: Do not upset the tray when you leave the room.
examples.cn: 出房间时别把托盘碰翻。

examples.en: He was upset for days after the interview.
examples.cn: 面试之后他难受了好几天。

examples.en: The young team upset the favourites in the semi-final.
examples.cn: 这支年轻球队在半决赛爆冷击败了夺冠热门。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「阿婆塞特」——阿婆塞东西太用力，一下把瓶罐塞翻在地，全家都慌了神。

root: 中古英语 upsetten，由 up（向上）与 setten（放置）复合，原义「竖起、翻覆」，后经「打翻」引申出「打乱、使心烦、爆冷」等义

sensesIntro.en: One tip-over spreads from cups to plans, to a person's mood, to a stomach, to a final score.
sensesIntro.cn: 一次翻倒，从杯子蔓延到计划、人的心情、肠胃，以至终场比分。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a cup knocked over at the table.
core.cn: 核心意象：桌上被碰倒的一只杯子。

branches.en: The object branch: a container goes down on its side.
branches.cn: 物件分支：容器倒向一边。

branches.en: The feeling branch: a mind knocked off its base.
branches.cn: 情绪分支：心意被撞离了底座。

branches.en: The order branch: arrangements turned over.
branches.cn: 秩序分支：安排被翻乱。

branches.en: The contest branch: the expected result is overturned.
branches.cn: 比赛分支：被认定会赢的结局被推翻。

branches.en: The body and score branches: stomach and upset result.
branches.cn: 身体与比分分支：翻搅的肠胃与意外的结果。

intro.en: Two of the commonest English words joined in one verb, with forms that never change.
intro.cn: 两个最常见的英语词合为一个动词，形态从不变化。

latinIntro.en: The Latin verb behind the idea is evertere, to turn out or overturn.
latinIntro.cn: 这一概念背后的拉丁动词是 evertere（翻出、推翻）。

The cat knocked over the vase.

definition_zh: 使用；利用；消耗；用掉；对待
definition_en: to do something with a tool or thing for a purpose, or to take and consume something
core_image: 伸手把工具从抽屉里拿出来握在手中
scene: 厨房的抽屉一拉开，里面躺着各式各样的工具，母亲总能顺手拿出合适的那个。A good cook knows how to use every pot in the kitchen.
sceneCN: 这里 use 是「使用、利用」（第 1 个义项：拿工具去做事）；句意为好厨师懂得使用厨房里的每一口锅。伸手取工具的这幅画面，正是这个词的核心。

derivatives.zh: 动词加 -er 构成，义为「用户；使用者」
加名词后缀 -age 构成，义为「用法；使用量」
加 -ful 构成，义为「有用的」
加 -less 构成，义为「无用的」
加 -able 构成，义为「可用的」

senses.title: To employ a thing for a purpose
senses.definition: to do something with a tool, object, or method in order to achieve a result
senses.definitionCN: 为了达到某个结果而用工具、物品或方法去做事
senses.example: She used a sharp knife to cut the bread.
senses.exampleCN: 她用一把快刀切面包。
senses.why: The verb names the act of taking something into one's hands and making it serve a purpose.
senses.whyCN: 这个词最初就指「把东西拿到手里，让它为自己办事」，取用工具的意象就是它的本义。

senses.title: To spend or consume a supply
senses.definition: to consume an amount of something such as time, money, or fuel
senses.definitionCN: 消耗掉一定量的时间、金钱或燃料等
senses.example: The old truck uses a lot of fuel.
senses.exampleCN: 这辆旧卡车很费油。
senses.why: Whatever is put to work is partly spent in the process, so the same verb comes to mean using up a supply.
senses.whyCN: 东西一旦被动用来干活，过程中总要耗掉一部分，于是同一个动词就引申为「耗用」。

senses.title: The act or purpose of employing something
senses.definition: as a noun, the act of employing something or the purpose it serves
senses.definitionCN: 作名词时指使用的行为，或某物所起的作用
senses.example: This room is for the use of guests only.
senses.exampleCN: 这个房间仅供客人使用。
senses.why: The nouns formed from the verb simply name the action itself and the end it serves.
senses.whyCN: 由这个动词转成的名词只是把「使用」这个动作本身和它所服务的目的命名下来。

senses.title: To treat someone in a particular way
senses.definition: to behave towards somebody in a stated manner, often unfairly
senses.definitionCN: 以某种方式对待某人，常含有不公平的意味
senses.example: He felt that his boss had used him badly.
senses.exampleCN: 他觉得老板待他很刻薄。
senses.why: To use people is to treat them as tools; from that picture the verb widens into simply meaning to treat.
senses.whyCN: 把人当工具使，就是把对方当成器物；从这个画面出发，词义又扩大到泛指的「对待」。

senses.title: To take a drug or apply a substance
senses.definition: to take a drug, medicine, or other substance regularly or deliberately
senses.definitionCN: 有意识地、经常地服用药物或使用某种物质
senses.example: The doctor told him to use the cream twice a day.
senses.exampleCN: 医生让他每天涂两次这种药膏。
senses.why: Medicine is a supply applied to the body for a result, so it slips naturally into the same frame.
senses.whyCN: 药物就是施用于身体、换取疗效的东西，于是它自然套进了同一个句法框架。

intro.en: A short word from Old French, ultimately from Latin, that has kept its shape almost unchanged for eight centuries.
intro.cn: 一个来自古法语、最终可溯至拉丁语的小词，八百年来词形几乎没有变化。

items.en: Usus, the past participle of uti, meant a using or a practice, and usare was a frequentative form of the same verb.
items.cn: usus 是 uti 的过去分词，意为「使用、惯行」；usare 是同一动词的反复体形式。

items.en: Us, user, and the past participle usé carried the verb into everyday French for using and wearing out.
items.cn: us、user 以及过去分词 usé 把这个动词带进日常法语，兼表「使用」与「用旧」。

items.en: English borrows the verb in the thirteenth century as usen, with the noun use beside it.
items.cn: 英语在十三世纪以 usen 的形式借入这个动词，名词 use 并行存在。

items.en: Spelling settles on use, and the word already covers tools, supplies, and medicine.
items.cn: 拼写固定为 use，词义这时已覆盖工具、物资与药物。

items.en: The question what is this used for turns the verb and noun into the commonest way of asking about purpose.
items.cn: what is this used for 这类问句让动词和名词成为询问用途最常用的手段。

note.en: The look-alike group collects the close relatives of the verb, while the near-meaning group sets tools against overuse and waste.
note.cn: 形近组收集这个动词的近亲，近义组则把使用与误用、滥用、浪费放在一起对照。

normalIntro.en: Three letters that name the everyday act of taking a thing and making it work for you.
normalIntro.cn: 三个字母，命名的是日常里把东西拿来替你办事的动作。

normal.en: Use up means finish the supply, as in use up all the paper.
normal.cn: use up 表示把存货用尽，如 use up all the paper。

normal.en: Make use of is the fixed phrase for turning something to your advantage.
normal.cn: make use of 是「加以利用」的固定说法。

normal.en: In use describes a machine that is working at this moment.
normal.cn: in use 形容机器此刻正在使用中。

normal.en: The noun use is pronounced with a soft s, the verb with a hard z.
normal.cn: 名词 use 末尾读清音 s，动词则读浊音 z。

normal.en: User, usage, useful, and useless all sit on this same short base.
normal.cn: user、usage、useful、useless 都建立在这个短词干上。

abstract.en: Picture a drawer of knives and spoons, and a hand closing on exactly the right one.
abstract.cn: 想象一抽屉的刀叉勺子，一只手正好抓住了对的那一件。

abstract.en: Feel the grip of a handle that many other hands have worn smooth.
abstract.cn: 体会一只被许多只手磨得光滑的把手。

abstract.en: Watch a full jar of coffee slowly empty day after day.
abstract.cn: 看着满满一罐咖啡一天天空下去。

examples.en: She used an old spoon to dig a hole for the seeds.
examples.cn: 她用一把旧勺子挖了个坑埋种子。

examples.en: We used up all the firewood before the snow came.
examples.cn: 雪落下之前我们把木柴都用光了。

examples.en: Learning to use a map is still a useful skill on long hikes.
examples.cn: 学会用地图在长途徒步中仍是一项有用的技能。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「优使」——把最好用的工具交给能干的人去使用。

root: 拉丁语 uti（使用）及其过去分词 usus、反复体 usare，经古法语 us / user 进入英语

sensesIntro.en: One act of taking a thing into service spreads to spending supplies, to the act itself, to treating people, and to taking medicine.
sensesIntro.cn: 从「把东西拿来用」这一个动作出发，词义扩展到耗用物资、使用行为、对待他人以及服用药物。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand taking a tool and putting it to work.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手取出工具，让它开始干活。

branches.en: The tool branch: a thing made to serve a purpose.
branches.cn: 工具分支：让某物为某个目的服务。

branches.en: The supply branch: use eats into a store of fuel, money, or time.
branches.cn: 物资分支：使用会吃掉油、钱、时间的存量。

branches.en: The noun branch: the act itself and the purpose it serves.
branches.cn: 名词分支：使用这一行为以及它服务的目的。

branches.en: The people branch: treating someone as a tool.
branches.cn: 人事分支：把某人当作工具来对待。

branches.en: The medicine branch: a substance applied for a result.
branches.cn: 药物分支：为求疗效而施用的物质。

intro.en: The word is barely analysable today, but two Latin pieces are still readable behind it.
intro.cn: 这个词如今几乎无法拆分，但其背后仍能读出两个拉丁成分。

latinIntro.en: The Latin verb uti, to use, gives usus and the frequentative usare; the short stem is all that survives in English.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁动词 uti（使用）给出 usus 与反复体 usare，英语只留下了这条短词干。

items.example: The stem us- carries the whole idea of using.
items.exampleCN: 词干 us- 承载了「使用」的全部含义。

items.example: Use as a verb keeps a silent final e.
items.exampleCN: 作动词的 use 末尾有一个不发音的 e。

items.example: Use gives user, a person who uses.
items.exampleCN: use 加它成为 user，即使用者。

items.example: Usage means the way or amount of use.
items.exampleCN: usage 表示用法或使用量。

items.example: Usable means able to be used.
Misuse is the wrong kind of use.

definition_zh: 通常的；平常的；一贯的；惯常的
definition_en: happening or done most of the time, and therefore normal for a person or place
core_image: 每天早上七点同一个座位上一杯同样的咖啡
scene: 清晨的小店刚开门，靠窗那张桌子已经坐上了熟客，点的还是那杯不加水的美式。He sat at his usual table and ordered the same coffee.
sceneCN: 这里 usual 是「通常的、惯常的」（第 1 个义项：多数时候都如此）；句意为老顾客坐着他常坐的那张桌子，喝着常点的咖啡。每天早上同一杯咖啡的画面，正是这个词的核心。

derivatives.zh: 加 -ly 构成副词，义为「通常；一般」
加否定前缀 un-，义为「不寻常的」
同根动词，义为「使用」
同根名词，义为「用法；惯例」

senses.title: What normally happens
senses.definition: describing what happens most often or is most often seen
senses.definitionCN: 形容最常发生或最常见的情况
senses.example: The usual bus is ten minutes late in the rain.
senses.exampleCN: 下雨时那班常坐的公交总会晚十分钟。
senses.why: The Latin source names what custom has made habitual, and habit is simply what happens most of the time.
senses.whyCN: 这个词的拉丁来源指「习俗使之成为常态的东西」，而习惯也就是大多数时候都会发生的事。

senses.title: Customary for one person or place
senses.definition: describing a fixed habit of one particular person, family, or shop
senses.definitionCN: 形容某个人、家庭或店铺固定不变的习惯
senses.example: She took her usual walk along the river after dinner.
senses.exampleCN: 晚饭后她照例沿着河走一走。
senses.why: Custom is personal as well as general, so the word also marks the private routines that repeat every day.
senses.whyCN: 习俗既属于众人也属于个人，所以这个词也用来标记每天重复的私人习惯。

senses.title: The ordinary option in a shop
senses.definition: in informal speech, the food or drink one always orders
senses.definitionCN: 口语中指某人每次固定点的那份饮食
senses.example: The waiter brought him the usual without asking.
senses.exampleCN: 服务员问都没问就给他端来了老样子。
senses.why: Once a choice is repeated often enough, it becomes a name in itself, and people simply order the usual.
senses.whyCN: 一个选择重复得够多就成了它自己的名字，人们于是干脆说「老样子」。

senses.title: That is as expected, nothing new
senses.definition: used of an unpleasant event that is exactly what one would expect
senses.definitionCN: 用于形容某件不愉快的事完全在意料之中
senses.example: His usual excuse was that the train was late again.
senses.exampleCN: 他还是那套老借口：火车又晚点了。
senses.why: Because habitual things are predictable, the word easily carries a faint tone of weary expectation.
senses.whyCN: 惯常之事总是可预料的，于是这个词也容易带上一丝厌烦的「又是这样」的意味。

intro.en: From Latin through French: a word about custom and habit, whose base is shared with use.
intro.cn: 经由法语来自拉丁语：一个关于习俗与习惯的词，其词基与 use 同源。

items.en: Usus meant use, practice, and custom; usualis described what custom made ordinary.
items.cn: usus 意为使用、实践与习俗；usualis 形容习俗使之成为常态的事物。

items.en: The form usualis is recorded as an adjective of everyday practice.
items.cn: usualis 这一形式有记录，用作指日常实践的形容词。

items.en: Usuel and the learned usual entered French usage alongside the everyday us.
items.cn: usuel 与书面形式 usual 同日常的 us 一起在法语中并行。

items.en: Usual enters English in the fourteenth century, first in legal and church writing.
items.cn: usual 于十四世纪进入英语，最早见于法律与教会文书。

items.en: The everyday phrases as usual and business as usual make the word home in ordinary speech.
items.cn: as usual 与 business as usual 这些日常说法让这个词彻底扎根于口语。

note.en: The look-alike group shows the use family behind usual, and the near-meaning group gathers words for what is normal.
note.cn: 形近组展示 usual 背后的 use 词族，近义组汇集表示「正常」的一类词。

normalIntro.en: Think of custom turned into an adjective: what a person or place always does.
normalIntro.cn: 把「习俗」变成形容词来想：某个人或某个地方总是这么做。

normal.en: As usual is a two-word phrase meaning in the normal way.
normal.cn: as usual 是两个词组成的短语，意为「像平常一样」。

normal.en: Business as usual says that nothing has changed.
normal.cn: business as usual 表示一切照旧。

normal.en: The adverb usually is far more frequent in speech than the adjective.
normal.cn: 副词 usually 在口语中比形容词本身常用得多。

normal.en: Unusual is the common opposite, formed with un-.
normal.cn: unusual 是用 un- 构成的常见反义词。

normal.en: Usual shares its root with use and usage.
normal.cn: usual 与 use、usage 同根。

abstract.en: Picture the same window seat taken every morning at seven.
abstract.cn: 想象每天早上七点都占着同一个靠窗座位。

abstract.en: Hear a waiter say the usual before you sit down.
abstract.cn: 听服务员在你落座前就说「老样子」。

abstract.en: Notice a worn path across the grass where everyone walks.
abstract.cn: 留意草地上被大家踩出来的一条小径。

examples.en: As usual, she arrived ten minutes before the meeting began.
examples.cn: 像往常一样，她在会议开始前十分钟就到了。

examples.en: He ordered his usual soup and read the paper.
examples.cn: 他点了常喝的那份汤，看着报纸。

examples.en: The shop keeps its usual hours even during the holiday.
examples.cn: 假期里这家店也保持着平常的营业时间。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「优若」——习惯的事做起来总是优若自然，不必多想。

root: 拉丁语 usus（使用、实践、习俗）派生 usualis，经古法语 usuel / usual 进入英语，义为「按习俗常行的」

sensesIntro.en: From custom comes what happens most of the time, then personal routines, then the fixed order, and finally the weary expected excuse.
sensesIntro.cn: 从习俗出发，先指多数时候发生的事，再指个人日常、固定点单，最后是那句听腻了的预料之中的借口。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the same seat and the same coffee every morning.
core.cn: 核心意象：每天早上同一张座位、同一杯咖啡。

branches.en: The habit branch: what happens on most days.
branches.cn: 习惯分支：大多数日子都会发生的事。

branches.en: The person branch: this family or shop always does so.
branches.cn: 个体分支：这一家、这一店总是如此。

branches.en: The order branch: the dish repeated until it has a name.
branches.cn: 点单分支：重复到有了名字的那份菜。

branches.en: The excuse branch: expected, and therefore tiring.
branches.cn: 借口分支：全然预料之中，因此令人厌倦。

branches.en: The expectation branch: habit makes events predictable.
branches.cn: 预期分支：习惯让事情变得可以预测。

intro.en: An adjective ending on a stem shared with use, formed in Latin and polished in French.
intro.cn: 一个形容词，接在与 use 同源的词干上，成形于拉丁语，经法语打磨。

latinIntro.en: Latin usus, use and custom, yields the adjective usualis, whose ending -alis becomes English -al.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 usus（使用与习俗）派生出形容词 usualis，其词尾 -alis 变成英语的 -al。

items.example: The stem us- carries the idea of custom.
items.exampleCN: 词干 us- 承载「习俗」之义。

items.example: Usually marks what happens in the normal way.
items.exampleCN: usually 标记按常规发生的事。

items.example: Usualness is rarely needed in speech.
items.exampleCN: usualness 在口语中很少用到。

items.example: Use and usual share one root.

items.exampleCN: usage 记录习俗所认可的说法。

items.example: Custom is the plain English partner.
items.exampleCN: custom 是这个词朴素的英语伙伴。

definition_zh: 假期；度假；休庭期
definition_en: a period of time away from work or school, often spent travelling
core_image: 行李箱敞在床上，一半是泳衣一半是防晒霜
scene: 七月的最后一天，办公室的灯一盏盏关掉，同事把文件夹压在桌上，说下周谁也不许找他。They spent their vacation on a quiet island.
sceneCN: 这里 vacation 是「假期」（第 1 个义项：离开工作或学习的休假期）；句意为他们在一个安静的小岛上度假。敞开的行李箱，正是这个词的核心。

derivatives.zh: 同根动词，义为「腾出；空出」
同根形容词，义为「空的；空缺的」
同根名词，义为「空缺；空房」
加 -er 构成，义为「度假者」

senses.title: Time away from work or school
senses.definition: a period of some days or weeks when work or school stops
senses.definitionCN: 工作或学习停顿的一段天数或周数
senses.example: They took a three-week vacation in the mountains.
senses.exampleCN: 他们在山里休了三周假。
senses.why: The Latin noun first named a being free of duties, so the holiday is simply the period when those duties are lifted.
senses.whyCN: 这个拉丁名词最初指「免除职责」这一状态，所以假期就是职责被撤下的那段时间。

senses.title: A trip taken during such time
senses.definition: used of travelling or resting away from home during a holiday
senses.definitionCN: 指在假期里离家旅行或休息
senses.example: The whole family spent the vacation by the sea.
senses.exampleCN: 一家人整个假期都待在海边。
senses.why: Once the days are free, the journey that fills them takes the same name, and the trip becomes the vacation.
senses.whyCN: 日子一旦空出来，填满它的旅程也取了同样的名字，旅行本身就成了 vacation。

senses.title: A break granted by a court or office
senses.definition: a fixed break for a court or an institution
senses.definitionCN: 法院或机构固定的休止期
senses.example: The court is in vacation until early September.
senses.exampleCN: 法院休庭到九月初。
senses.why: Institutions also empty out for fixed weeks, so law keeps the word for the bench left sitting idle.
senses.whyCN: 机构也会在固定的几周里空下来，法律便用这个词指闲着的法官席。

senses.title: The act of giving up a post
senses.definition: in older use, the act of vacating a position or a place
senses.definitionCN: 旧时用法，指辞去或腾出一个职位、一处场所
senses.example: His vacation of the chair left the office empty for a year.
senses.exampleCN: 他辞去这一席位，让该职位空了一年。
senses.why: This is the oldest legal sense: the act of making a place empty by leaving it.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老的法律义：离开一处场所，从而使它空出来。

intro.en: A Latin noun of exemption from duty, whose root also gives vacant and vacuum.
intro.cn: 一个表示「免除职责」的拉丁名词，其词根也给出 vacant 与 vacuum。

items.en: Vacare meant to be free of duty, and vacatio named the state of being exempt.
items.cn: vacare 意为「免于职责」，vacatio 指处于免除状态。

items.en: In legal use vacatio covered the free days of courts, when no case was heard.
items.cn: 在法律用语中，vacatio 指法院不审案的空闲日子。

items.en: Vacation carried the legal and ecclesiastical sense into French.
items.cn: vacation 把法律与教会的这层含义带进法语。

items.en: English borrows the word in the fourteenth century, first for the law courts and the universities.
items.cn: 英语在十四世纪借入这个词，最初用于法院与大学。

items.en: From the nineteenth century the word names the ordinary holiday of any worker.
items.cn: 自十九世纪起，这个词泛指任何工作者的普通假期。

note.en: The look-alike group shows the vac- family of freedom and emptiness, and the near-meaning group places rest beside work.
note.cn: 形近组展示表示「空、自由」的 vac- 词族，近义组把休息与工作相对照。

entries.definition: empty, not occupied
to leave a place empty
an empty room or job
a calling to a kind of work, only the ending is close, the root is different
entries.definitionCN: 职业；只是词尾相近，词源不同

entries.definition: time off in British English
a short period of rest
official time away from work
the working part of a school year

normalIntro.en: A vacation is literally an emptying of the calendar: the days are cleared and left free.
normalIntro.cn: vacation 字面上就是把日历腾空：日子被清出来，空着。

normal.en: Go on vacation and take a vacation are the two set phrases.
normal.cn: go on vacation 与 take a vacation 是两个固定说法。

normal.en: American English says vacation where British English says holiday.
normal.cn: 美式说 vacation，英式说 holiday。

normal.en: The legal sense survives in court in vacation.
normal.cn: 法律义仍留在 court in vacation 这样的说法里。

normal.en: The root vac- links vacation to vacant and vacancy.
normal.cn: 词根 vac- 把 vacation 与 vacant、vacancy 连起来。

normal.en: Vacationer is mainly American and means a traveller on holiday.
normal.cn: vacationer 主要是美式用法，指度假的游客。

abstract.en: Picture a suitcase half packed at the foot of a bed.
abstract.cn: 想象床脚一只装了一半的箱子。

abstract.en: See a desk calendar with two empty weeks crossed out in yellow.
abstract.cn: 看台历上被黄色涂掉的两个空周。

abstract.en: Hear the click of office lights going off one by one.
abstract.cn: 听办公室的灯一盏盏关掉的声音。

examples.en: We spent our vacation walking in the hills.
examples.cn: 我们假期在山里徒步。

examples.en: She booked two weeks of vacation in August.
examples.cn: 她订了八月两周的休假。

examples.en: The court will sit again after the long vacation.
examples.cn: 法院在长休庭期之后会再次开庭。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「我会开心」——假期一到，我就会开心。

root: 拉丁语 vacare（空着、免于职责）→ vacatio（免除职务、空闲），经古法语 vacation 进入英语

sensesIntro.en: An emptying of duty becomes the free time, then the trip taken in it, then an institution's pause, and in old law a post given up.
sensesIntro.cn: 把职责腾空，先成空出的时间，再成填满它的旅行，再成机构的停歇，旧法里还指让出的职位。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a suitcase half packed on a bed.
core.cn: 核心意象：床上一只装了一半的行李箱。

branches.en: The leaving branch: walking out of the office.
branches.cn: 出发分支：走出办公室。

branches.en: The trip branch: a fortnight on an island.
branches.cn: 旅行分支：在岛上待两周。

branches.en: The court branch: the bench is empty in September.
branches.cn: 法院分支：九月里法官席空着。

branches.en: The old branch: the chair left without a holder.
branches.cn: 旧分支：席位无人担任。

branches.en: The blend: holiday and journey share one noun today.
branches.cn: 融合分支：今天假期与旅程共用一个名词。

intro.en: The Latin root of emptiness plus the noun ending of state: an emptied calendar.
intro.cn: 拉丁语「空」词根加表示状态的名词词尾：被腾空的日历。

latinIntro.en: Vacare, to be free, gives vacatio; the ending -atio becomes English -ation as in creation and relation.
latinIntro.cn: vacare（自由无事）给出 vacatio；词尾 -atio 在英语中变为 -ation，如 creation、relation。

items.example: Vacation is a time left free.
Creation and relation share the ending.
items.exampleCN: creation 与 relation 共用这一词尾。

items.example: Holiday keeps day at the end.

definition_zh: 价值；价格；重要性；重视；估量
definition_en: the worth of something in money or in importance, or to think highly of it
core_image: 旧货商把一只旧表端在手里，翻看背面刻字
scene: 旧货铺里，老板把一只黄铜表翻过来，看背面的刻字和磨损，然后才报出一个数。The dealer set a value of two hundred on the watch.
sceneCN: 这里 value 是「价值、估价」（第 1 个义项：值多少）；句意为旧货商给那只表估了两百。端表翻看的画面，正是这个词的核心。

derivatives.zh: 加 -able 构成形容词，义为「有价值的」
加 in- 与 -able 构成，义为「无价的」
加 -ation 构成名词，义为「估价」
加 -less 构成，义为「毫无价值的」

senses.title: Worth in money
senses.definition: the amount of money something is worth or would sell for
senses.definitionCN: 某物值多少钱或能卖多少钱
senses.example: The value of the house has doubled in ten years.
senses.exampleCN: 这栋房子十年间价值翻了一倍。
senses.why: Latin valere meant to be worth, and the noun first names what a thing can be exchanged for.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 valere 意为「值得」，这个名词最初指一件东西能换来的那个数目。

senses.title: Worth in importance
senses.definition: the importance or usefulness of something that is not for sale
senses.definitionCN: 某些非卖品的重要性或用处
senses.example: The value of the trip lay in the people she met.
senses.exampleCN: 这趟旅行的价值在于她遇见的人。
senses.why: If worth can be counted, it need not be counted in coins, so the word moves to things that are priceless.
senses.whyCN: 既然「值」可以计量，就不必只以钱币计量，于是词义挪到了无价之物上。

senses.title: To think highly of something
senses.definition: to consider something important and worth keeping
senses.definitionCN: 认为某物重要、值得保留
senses.example: He values his friends more than his salary.
senses.exampleCN: 他看重朋友胜过薪水。
senses.why: To see worth in something is to prize it, so the noun becomes a verb of holding dear.
senses.whyCN: 看出一件事的价值就是看重它，于是名词转成了表示珍惜的动词。

senses.title: To estimate the worth of something
senses.definition: to work out how much money something is worth
senses.definitionCN: 算定某物值多少钱
senses.example: The house was valued at a lower figure last year.
senses.exampleCN: 这栋房子去年的估价更低。
senses.why: The other verb use keeps the money sense: to value is to put a figure on what something is worth.
senses.whyCN: 动词的另一用法保留了钱款义：value 就是给某物定一个价。

senses.title: A belief about what matters
senses.definition: in the plural, the beliefs a person or group holds about right and wrong
senses.definitionCN: 复数形式指个人或群体对是非的观念
senses.example: The school says it teaches traditional values.
senses.exampleCN: 这所学校称它教授传统观念。
senses.why: The things a group prizes are its values, so the plural names beliefs rather than prices.
senses.whyCN: 一个群体所看重的东西就是它的 values，因此复数指观念而不是价格。

intro.en: The Latin root of worth, borrowed through French as a noun and then turned into a verb in English.
intro.cn: 拉丁语「值得」的词根，经法语借入作名词，后在英语中转为动词。

items.en: Valere meant to be strong or to be worth, and valor named worth and courage.
items.cn: valere 意为「强壮、值得」，valor 指价值与勇气。

items.en: The feminine participle valuta meant a thing worth so much.
items.cn: 阴性分词 valuta 意为「值若干的东西」。

items.en: French valoir and the noun value carried the sense of worth into use.
items.cn: 法语 valoir 与名词 value 把「值」这一意义带入使用。

items.en: English borrows value as a noun of price and worth.
items.cn: 英语在十四世纪借入 value，作价格与价值的名词。

items.en: The verb senses of prizing and pricing grow, and the plural values names beliefs.
items.cn: 表示珍视与估价的动词义发展起来，复数 values 指观念。

note.en: The look-alike group holds the worth family, and the near-meaning group sets worth against price and cost.
note.cn: 形近组收集表示「值」的词族，近义组把价值与价格、成本放在一起。
