legally or logically sound
an estimate of worth
courage in battle
the native word for value
the money asked for goods
what is given up to get something
worth of a good quality

normalIntro.en: One noun covers both the price on a tag and the worth a person refuses to sell.
normalIntro.cn: 一个名词同时覆盖标签上的价格与人情里不肯出售的价值。

normal.en: Value for money is the standard phrase in shopping and reviews.
normal.cn: value for money 是购物与评测中的标准说法。

normal.en: Values in the plural means beliefs, not prices.
normal.cn: 复数 values 指观念，不是价格。

normal.en: The verb takes both frames: value a friend, value a house.
normal.cn: 这个动词两种框架都用：value a friend 与 value a house。

normal.en: Valuable and invaluable look like opposites but are not.
normal.cn: valuable 与 invaluable 看着像反义，其实不是。

normal.en: Valuation is the formal word from the same stem.
normal.cn: valuation 是同词干上的正式名词。

abstract.en: Picture a dealer turning a brass watch to read the engraving.
abstract.cn: 想象旧货商翻过黄铜表看刻字。

abstract.en: See a friend keep a letter that has no price at all.
abstract.cn: 看朋友留着一封无从标价的信。

abstract.en: Hear a school claim it teaches old-fashioned values.
abstract.cn: 听一所学校说它教老式的观念。

examples.en: The value of the land rose sharply after the road was built.
examples.cn: 修路之后这块地的价值猛涨。

examples.en: She values honesty more than politeness.
examples.cn: 她看重诚实胜过礼貌。

examples.en: The painting was valued at ten thousand pounds.
examples.cn: 这幅画被估价一万英镑。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「为留」——有价值的东西才值得为之留下来。

root: 拉丁语 valere（值得、强壮）的阴性分词 valuta（价值），经古法语 value 进入英语

sensesIntro.en: The core of worth gives money, then importance, then the two verbs of prizing and pricing, and finally the beliefs people hold.
sensesIntro.cn: 「值得」这个核心先给出钱款，再给出重要性，再给出珍视与估价两个动词，最后给出人们所持的观念。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a dealer turning a brass watch in his hands.
core.cn: 核心意象：旧货商手里翻看一只黄铜表。

branches.en: The price branch: a figure on a tag.
branches.cn: 价格分支：标签上的数字。

branches.en: The meaning branch: worth without a price.
branches.cn: 意义分支：无价的价值。

branches.en: The holding branch: friendship kept above salary.
branches.cn: 持有分支：友情重于薪水。

branches.en: The pricing branch: an expert puts a number on it.
branches.cn: 定价分支：专家给出一个数字。

branches.en: The belief branch: shared ideas of what matters.
branches.cn: 观念分支：共同认定的重要之事。

intro.en: A Latin root of worth carried into English through French, later hosting a crowd of suffixes.
intro.cn: 一个表示「值得」的拉丁词根经法语进入英语，后来又接上了一大串后缀。

latinIntro.en: Valere, to be worth, gives valuta; French shortens it to value, and English takes value as both noun and verb.
latinIntro.cn: valere（值得）给出 valuta；法语缩为 value，英语把 value 同时用作名词与动词。

items.example: The root covers worth and strength together.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根同时覆盖价值与强壮。

items.example: The ending shows a borrowed noun.
items.exampleCN: 这一词尾显示是借入名词。

items.example: Worth and value answer each other.
items.exampleCN: worth 与 value 彼此对应。

latinEntries.meaning: to be worth, to be strong

definition_zh: 蔬菜；植物（总称，较旧用法）；形容词：植物的、蔬菜的；植物人（口语，多用于 be a vegetable）
definition_en: a plant or part of a plant eaten as food, such as a carrot or cabbage
core_image: 菜篮里横着一根带泥的胡萝卜，叶子还挂着水珠
scene: 厨房案板上摊着刚洗好的青菜、辣椒和番茄，水还在滴。She grows most of her own vegetables in a small garden.
sceneCN: 这里 vegetable 是「蔬菜」（第 1 个义项：可食用的植物或其部分）；句意为她大部分的蔬菜都种在自己的小园子里。菜篮里那根带泥的胡萝卜，就是这个词的样子。

derivatives.zh: 名词，义为「素食者」，由本词加 -arian 构成
名词，义为「植被、草木」，同源于拉丁语 vegetare「生长」
动词，义为「生长；无所事事地过日子」
形容词，义为「植物的」，较书面

senses.title: Food from plants
senses.titleCN: 蔬菜：可吃的植物或其部分
senses.definition: a plant or part of a plant used as food, such as cabbage or carrot
senses.definitionCN: 可食用的植物或其部分，如甘蓝、胡萝卜
senses.example: She grows most of her own vegetables in a small garden.
senses.exampleCN: 她大部分的蔬菜都种在自己的小园子里。
senses.why: Latin vegetare means to grow; a vegetable is simply the part of a growing plant that reaches the table.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 vegetare 意为生长；蔬菜就是生长中的植物里走上餐桌的那一部分。

senses.title: Plants in general
senses.titleCN: 植物：较旧的总称，常带科学色彩
senses.definition: a plant or plant life in general, in older or scientific writing
senses.definitionCN: 笼统指植物，见于较早或科学性的文字
senses.example: The museum has a large collection of fossils of ancient vegetables.
senses.exampleCN: 博物馆收藏了大量古代植物的化石。
senses.why: The older sense covers the whole kingdom; the kitchen sense pulled one part of it away.
senses.whyCN: 较旧的含义覆盖整个界，厨房用法把其中一部分拽了出来。

senses.title: Of plants
senses.titleCN: 植物的：作定语说明来源
senses.definition: used before a noun to mean made from or of plants
senses.definitionCN: 用在名词前，表示由植物制成或与植物有关
senses.example: The soup was cooked in vegetable oil rather than butter.
senses.exampleCN: 汤是用植物油而不是黄油煮的。
senses.why: As a modifier the word labels a source, not a kind of plant.
senses.whyCN: 作修饰语时，这个词标的是来源，而不是某种植物。

senses.title: A person without response
senses.titleCN: 植物人：口语里形容毫无反应的人
senses.definition: in informal medical talk, a person alive but unable to respond or move
senses.definitionCN: 口语医疗说法，指活着却无法回应或活动的人
senses.example: He was no longer ill, but he lay as a vegetable for years.
senses.exampleCN: 他的病已不是问题，却像植物人一样躺了多年。
senses.why: The metaphor is blunt: only growth remains, all communication gone.
senses.whyCN: 这个比喻很直接：只剩生长，一切交流都消失了。

intro.en: Vegetable comes from Latin vegetabilis, able to grow, from the verb vegetare, to be lively.
intro.cn: vegetable 来自拉丁语 vegetabilis「能生长的」，出自动词 vegetare「有生气、生长」。

items.en: The verb vegere meant to be active or lively, applied to anything growing and powered.
items.cn: 动词 vegere 意为有活力、活跃，用于正在生长、有生机的东西。

items.en: Its frequentative vegetare meant to animate or make grow, the root of the whole family.
items.cn: 其反复态 vegetare 意为使有生气、使生长，是整个词族的根。

items.en: The adjective vegetabilis meant capable of growth, applied to plants and soil.
items.cn: 形容词 vegetabilis 意为能生长的，用于植物与土壤。

items.en: Old French used vegetable for anything that grew, and English borrowed it in that sense.
items.cn: 古法语用 vegetable 指一切会生长之物，英语即以此义借入。

items.en: By the eighteenth century the kitchen sense had pushed the general one aside in daily speech.
items.cn: 到十八世纪，厨房里的用法在日常语言中把笼统的含义挤到了一边。

note.en: The look-alike group follows the grow- family; the near-meaning group holds plant foods and words for plants.
note.cn: 形近组沿「生长」词族；近义组收植物性食物与泛指植物的词。

entries.definition: A person who avoids meat; built on vegetable.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「素食者」，由本词构成。

entries.definition: Plant life as a whole, the old general sense.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「植被」，即较旧的笼统含义。

entries.definition: To grow as a plant, or to live without activity.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「生长」，也指无所事事地活着。

entries.definition: A learned adjective for plant life.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「植物的」，书面色彩。

entries.definition: One common vegetable, with its own round picture.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「卷心菜」，单一蔬菜，画面自成一格。

entries.definition: The seed-bearing part, a kitchen partner and rival.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「水果」，含籽的部分，厨房里的伙伴与对手。

entries.definition: Farm products sold together, fruit and vegetables at once.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「农产品」，把果蔬一起算。

entries.definition: Plants grown for harvest, seen as a field or yield.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「作物」，从田野与产量的角度看。

normalIntro.en: The hooks use the growing-plant root and the kitchen sense that now dominates.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子使用「生长植物」的词根，以及如今占主导的厨房含义。

normal.en: Vegetable comes from a Latin verb meaning to grow.
normal.cn: vegetable 出自一个意为「生长」的拉丁动词。

normal.en: Vegetables are eaten; a vegetarian eats no meat.
normal.cn: 蔬菜是吃的，而 vegetarian 是不吃肉的人。

normal.en: Vegetation is the old, wide sense: all of the plants.
normal.cn: vegetation 是旧的宽泛指：所有植物。

normal.en: Vegetable oil is oil pressed from plants, not from butter.
normal.cn: vegetable oil 是从植物压榨的油，不是黄油。

normal.en: A vegetable garden grows food, a flower garden grows beauty.
normal.cn: 菜园种食物，花园种美。

abstract.en: The word once meant anything that grows, and now means what we pick and cook.
abstract.cn: 这个词原指一切会生长之物，如今指我们采摘下锅的东西。

abstract.en: It marks a boundary humans drew, not one nature keeps: tomato is a fruit in botany and a vegetable in the kitchen.
abstract.cn: 它标的是人划的界线而非自然的：番茄在植物学是果实，在厨房是蔬菜。

abstract.en: From life to food to mere survival, the same root covers growth, harvest and the loss of speech.
abstract.cn: 从生命到食物再到只剩生存，同一个词根覆盖成长、收获与失语。

examples.en: Eat more fresh vegetables and less fried food.
examples.cn: 多吃新鲜蔬菜，少吃油炸食物。

examples.en: They planted vegetables behind the house.
examples.cn: 他们在屋后种了蔬菜。

examples.en: The dish is cooked with vegetable oil and garlic.
examples.cn: 这道菜用植物油和大蒜烹制。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「威治特波」——威（为）治特（吃）吧，多吃蔬菜：蔬菜

root: 源自拉丁语 vegetabilis「能生长的」，出自 vegetare「使生长」，经古法语 vegetable 进入英语；同族词有 vegetarian、vegetation、vegetate。

sensesIntro.en: Vegetable moves from the whole plant kingdom to the kitchen, then to a modifier and an old blunt figure of speech.
sensesIntro.cn: vegetable 从整个植物界走进厨房，再成为修饰语，最后化作一句直白的旧比喻。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a muddy carrot from the garden, leaves still beaded with water.
core.cn: 核心意象：一根带泥的胡萝卜，叶子还挂着水珠。

branches.en: KITCHEN LINE: the edible part of a plant.
branches.cn: 厨房线：植物可食的部分。

branches.en: BOTANY LINE: the whole plant world, an older use.
branches.cn: 植物学线：整个植物界，较旧用法。

branches.en: LABEL LINE: vegetable oil names a source.
branches.cn: 标签线：vegetable oil 标的是来源。

branches.en: LOSS LINE: life without response, a blunt metaphor.
branches.cn: 丧失线：只剩生命而无反应，直白比喻。

branches.en: CONTRAST: a vegetable is food, vegetable oil is a material.
branches.cn: 对照线：vegetable 是食物，vegetable oil 是原料。

intro.en: Vegetable keeps its Latin adjective ending; English relatives use -arian, -ation and -ate.
intro.cn: vegetable 保留了拉丁形容词词尾，英语亲属词则用 -arian、-ation、-ate。

latinIntro.en: The Latin chain is vegere, vegetare and vegetabilis, all about life and growth.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁链条是 vegere、vegetare、vegetabilis，都与生命和生长有关。

items.example: It shows the word as a modifier.

definition_zh: 车辆；交通工具；（思想、信息的）传播媒介、手段；载体
definition_en: a machine with wheels or an engine used for transport, or a means of expressing something
core_image: 一辆车停在站台边，门一开，车上的人和想法一起下车
scene: 早高峰的马路上一排车缓缓挪动，尾灯连成一条红线。No vehicle is allowed on this narrow path.
sceneCN: 这里 vehicle 是「车辆」（第 1 个义项：有轮或有发动机的运输工具）；句意为这条窄路上不允许车辆通行。站台边停着的那辆车，就是这个词的样子。

pos.zh: 名词：车辆、交通工具；传播媒介、手段；载体

derivatives.zh: 形容词，义为「车辆的、车辆使用的」
名词短语，义为「车辆交通」

senses.title: A machine for transport
senses.titleCN: 车辆：能载人载货的机器
senses.definition: a machine with wheels or an engine used to carry people or goods
senses.definitionCN: 有轮或发动机、用来载人或载货的机器
senses.example: No vehicle is allowed on this narrow path.
senses.exampleCN: 这条窄路上不允许车辆通行。
senses.why: Latin vehiculum named a plain means of carrying, and the road sense grew from it.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 vehiculum 原指一种朴素的「搬运手段」，道路上的含义由此长出来。

senses.title: A means of expression
senses.titleCN: 表达手段：让思想能走动的载体
senses.definition: a way or medium through which ideas or feelings are expressed
senses.definitionCN: 使思想或感情得以表达的方式或媒介
senses.example: The novel served as a vehicle for her views on education.
senses.exampleCN: 这部小说成了她表达教育观点的载体。
senses.why: What carries goods also carries ideas; the word moves from wheels to words.
senses.whyCN: 能载货的东西也能载思想；这个词从车轮走到了文字。

senses.title: A medium of transmission
senses.titleCN: 传播媒介：把信息或物质送到别处
senses.definition: a substance or channel that carries something to another place
senses.definitionCN: 把某物带到别处的物质或渠道
senses.example: Water is a common vehicle for disease in crowded cities.
senses.exampleCN: 在拥挤的城市里，水常是疾病的传播媒介。
senses.why: The word is neutral about what is carried: people, ideas or germs.
senses.whyCN: 这个词对载着什么保持中立：可以是人、思想或病菌。

senses.title: A medium in art and science
senses.titleCN: 溶剂、调色媒介：科学艺术里承载别物的东西
senses.definition: a liquid in which a substance is carried, as in paint or medicine
senses.definitionCN: 承载其他物质的液体，如颜料或药物里的媒介
senses.example: The pigments are held in an oil vehicle before the paint dries.
senses.exampleCN: 颜料在干之前由油性媒介承载。
senses.why: In a workshop the word returns to its plainest sense: something liquid does the carrying.
senses.whyCN: 在作坊里，这个词回到最朴素的意思：由一种液体来承担搬运。

intro.en: Vehicle comes from Latin vehiculum, a means of carrying, built from the verb vehere, to carry.
intro.cn: vehicle 来自拉丁语 vehiculum「搬运手段」，出自动词 vehere「运载」。

items.en: The verb vehere meant to carry or convey, said of riders, ships and carts.
items.cn: 动词 vehere 意为运载，用于骑手、船只和车。

items.en: Its noun vehiculum named any means of transport, not only a machine.
items.cn: 其名词 vehiculum 指任何运输手段，不只是机器。

items.en: French kept véhicule for carts and carriages, and English borrowed that sense.
items.cn: 法语保留 véhicule 指车马，英语借入的就是这一含义。

items.en: With the motor car the street sense tightened into vehicles on wheels.
items.cn: 随着汽车出现，日常含义收窄为带轮子的车辆。

items.en: At the same time the older sense of a carrier widened again into ideas and media.
items.cn: 与此同时，「承载物」的旧义又扩展开来，用于思想与媒介。

note.en: The look-alike group follows the veh- carrying stem; the near-meaning group holds transport words and carriers.
note.cn: 形近组沿表示「运载」的 veh- 词干；近义组收交通与承载相关的词。

entries.definition: Of or for vehicles; the adjective.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「车辆的」，是本词的形容词形式。

entries.definition: A blood vessel; sounds close but shares no root.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「血管」，音近但不同根。

entries.definition: To carry something across; formed with con-.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「运送、传达」，同一拉丁词根加 con-。

entries.definition: A journey by sea; from the same carrying verb.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「航行」，出自同一个运载动词。

entries.definition: A passenger road vehicle, the everyday word.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「小汽车」，最日常的说法。

entries.definition: The whole system of moving people and goods.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「运输」，指整套运送系统。

entries.definition: A channel for ideas or messages, the abstract sense.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「媒介」，即抽象的含义。

entries.definition: One that carries, used of people, bags or germs.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「携带者」，用于人、袋子或病菌。

normalIntro.en: The hooks use the carrying root and the double life of the word as transport and as medium.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子使用「运载」词根，以及这个词作为交通工具与媒介的双重身份。

normal.en: Vehicle comes from a Latin verb meaning to carry.
normal.cn: vehicle 出自一个意为「运载」的拉丁动词。

normal.en: Motor vehicle is the formal term in law and insurance.
normal.cn: motor vehicle 是法律与保险里的正式说法。

normal.en: A vehicle for change is a means, not a machine.
normal.cn: a vehicle for change 指手段，不是机器。

normal.en: Convey and voyage share the same root as vehicle.
normal.cn: convey 与 voyage 和 vehicle 同根。

normal.en: The plural is vehicles, with the k sound kept before the s.
normal.cn: 复数是 vehicles，k 音在 s 前仍然保留。

abstract.en: Everything in the word is about being carried: a body, an idea, a germ, a colour.
abstract.cn: 这个词说的全是「被载着」：身体、想法、病菌、颜色。

abstract.en: A vehicle changes the reach of what it carries; the idea is the same size, the audience is not.
abstract.cn: 交通工具改变的是所载之物的抵达范围；想法没变大，听众变大了。

abstract.en: The oldest sense was any means; modern life narrowed it to wheels and then quietly reopened it.
abstract.cn: 最古老的含义是任何手段；现代生活把它收窄到车轮，又悄悄打开。

examples.en: All vehicles must stop at the red light.
examples.cn: 所有车辆必须在红灯前停下。

examples.en: The film became a vehicle for young actors.
examples.cn: 这部电影成了年轻演员展示自己的载体。

examples.en: Mosquitoes are a vehicle for several diseases.
examples.cn: 蚊子是几种疾病的传播媒介。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「为爱扣」——为爱扣上车门，一路载着走：车辆

root: 源自拉丁语名词 vehiculum「运输手段」（动词 vehere「运载」），经法语 véhicule 进入英语；同族词有 convey、voyage、vehicular。

sensesIntro.en: Vehicle begins as anything that carries, narrows to cars, then widens back to ideas, germs and paint.
sensesIntro.cn: vehicle 起初指一切运载之物，收窄为车辆，又扩回思想、病菌与颜料。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a cart at the platform, doors open, passengers and their plans getting off together.
core.cn: 核心意象：站台边的一辆车，门一开，乘客和他们的计划一起下来。

branches.en: ROAD LINE: machines with wheels or engines.
branches.cn: 道路线：有轮或发动机的机器。

branches.en: ART LINE: a story that carries a point of view.
branches.cn: 艺术线：承载观点的小说或影片。

branches.en: CHANNEL LINE: water or insects carrying disease.
branches.cn: 渠道线：带病的水或昆虫。

branches.en: PAINT LINE: the liquid that holds pigment.
branches.cn: 颜料线：承载颜料的媒介。

branches.en: CONTRAST: transport is the system, a vehicle is one machine in it.
branches.cn: 对照线：transport 是系统，vehicle 是其中一台机器。

intro.en: Vehicle is a Latin noun; its relatives mostly come from the same carrying verb with other prefixes.
intro.cn: vehicle 是拉丁名词，亲属词多由同一运载动词加不同前缀构成。

latinIntro.en: The Latin base is vehere, to carry, giving vehiculum and also vector and convehere.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语基础是 vehere「运载」，派生出 vehiculum，也派生出 vector 与 convehere。

items.example: It is the core of vehicle.
It names the thing that carries.
It is the same journey idea.
items.exampleCN: 它带有同样的旅程观念。

items.structure: French noun from the same verb

definition_zh: 非常；很；（限定用法）正是那个；极端的
definition_en: to a high degree, and, before a noun, the actual or exact one
core_image: 温度计的红柱一路顶到最上面那格
scene: 面试官看完简历，抬头说了一句：这份作品集非常出色。The interviewer said that the portfolio was very impressive.
sceneCN: 这里 very 是「非常」（第 1 个义项：表示程度很高）；句意为面试官说这份作品集非常出色。温度计顶格的那个画面就是这个副词给人的感觉。

derivatives.zh: 短语，义为「非常；十分」
古旧副词，义为「确实地；真正地」

senses.title: To a high degree
senses.definition: used to strengthen an adjective or another adverb
senses.definitionCN: 用来加强形容词或副词的程度
senses.example: The interviewer said the portfolio was very impressive.
senses.exampleCN: 面试官说这份作品集非常出色。
senses.why: The oldest job of the word is simply to push a quality higher.
senses.whyCN: 这个词最古老的作用，就是把某种性质往上推高。

senses.title: In a high degree with verbs
senses.definition: used with some verbs and participles to mean greatly
senses.definitionCN: 与某些动词或分词连用，表示程度很高
senses.example: She was very pleased with the result.
senses.exampleCN: 她对结果非常满意。
senses.why: With a participle the same word shifts from modifying a quality to modifying an action.
senses.whyCN: 与分词连用时，同一个词从修饰性质转为修饰动作。

senses.title: The actual or exact one
senses.definition: used before a noun to single out the exact person or thing
senses.definitionCN: 用在名词前，指出正是某个人或某个事物
senses.example: That is the very book I was looking for.
senses.exampleCN: 那正是我在找的那本书。
senses.why: Pointing at one exact item is a short step from pushing a quality to its limit.
senses.whyCN: 从把性质推向极限，到指出唯一确切的那一个，只是一小步。

senses.title: The extreme end of something
senses.definition: used with a noun to mean the extreme or utmost
senses.definitionCN: 与名词连用，表示极端或极致
senses.example: They searched to the very end of the cave.
senses.exampleCN: 他们一直搜到洞穴的最深处。
senses.why: If a quality is pushed to the top, the noun that carries it is at its extreme.
senses.whyCN: 性质既被推到顶端，承载它的名词也就处在极端处。

senses.title: Used to add force in speech
senses.definition: used in speech for emphasis, as in the very idea
senses.definitionCN: 用于口语中加强语气，如 the very idea
senses.example: The very idea of moving abroad frightened him.
senses.exampleCN: 一想到要搬到国外，他就害怕。
senses.why: Emphasis in speech takes the same intensifying force and turns it on an idea.
senses.whyCN: 口语里的强调，把这股加强的力量转而用在某个念头上。

intro.en: Very began as a French adjective meaning true, and turned into the intensifier we use today.
intro.cn: very 最初是法语中意为「真实的」的形容词，后来变成今天的程度副词。

items.en: Verus meant true, and verax named the one who tells the truth.
items.cn: verus 意为真实的，verax 指说真话的人。

items.en: French verai carried the sense of genuine into everyday speech.
items.cn: 法语 verai 把「真正的」这一含义带入日常口语。

items.en: English verray first meant true or real, as in a verray friend.
items.cn: 中世纪英语 verray 最初意为真实的，如 a verray friend（真正的朋友）。

items.en: Placed before an adjective, it began to mean in a true degree, hence greatly.
items.cn: 放在形容词前时，它开始表示「真正地…」，进而表示「非常」。

items.en: The old sense survives only in fixed phrases such as the very same.
items.cn: 旧义如今只保留在 the very same 这类固定短语中。

note.en: The first group holds the small family of forms, the second the intensifiers and their opposites.
note.cn: 第一组是同族的小词群，第二组是程度副词及其反义说法。

entries.definition: truly, in old use
to a great degree
to check that something is true
to change or differ
to the highest degree
fairly, to a moderate degree
precise, with nothing added
to a small degree

normalIntro.en: From a Latin word for true to a word that simply turns the volume up: very has kept only its force.
normalIntro.cn: 从拉丁语中表示「真实」的词，到只负责把音量调大的词：very 只留下了那股加强的力量。

normal.en: Very and verify share the Latin root verus, true.
normal.cn: very 与 verify 同出拉丁语 verus（真实的）。

normal.en: Before a noun it means exact: the very man.
normal.cn: 放在名词前表示确切：the very man（正是那个人）。

normal.en: Before an adjective it means greatly: very cold.
normal.cn: 放在形容词前表示程度高：very cold（很冷）。

normal.en: It does not modify verbs directly; say very much like, not very like.
normal.cn: 它不直接修饰动词；要说 very much like，而非 very like。

normal.en: Comparative forms verier and veriest survive only in old books.
normal.cn: 比较级 verier、最高级 veriest 只存在于旧书中。

abstract.en: Picture a thermometer whose red line goes to the top mark.
abstract.cn: 想一支温度计的红线顶到最上面一格。

abstract.en: Feel a speaker leaning forward to press one word harder.
abstract.cn: 感受说话人身子前倾，把某一个词压得更重。

abstract.en: See a spotlight picking out one single chair on a stage.
abstract.cn: 想聚光灯在舞台上圈出唯一一把椅子。

examples.en: The soup is very hot, so let it cool for a minute.
examples.cn: 汤很烫，让它凉一分钟。

examples.en: This is the very place where the two roads meet.
examples.cn: 这里正是两条路交汇的地方。

examples.en: He was not very happy about the change of plan.
examples.cn: 他对计划的变更不太满意。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「外瑞」——外边那位瑞哥嗓门特别大，一说就是「非常」响。

root: 拉丁语 verus（真实的）→ 古法语 verai → 中世纪英语 verray（真正的）→ 现代英语 very（非常）

sensesIntro.en: One little word grows from true, through truly to a plain intensifier, and keeps a second life as exactly that one.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个小词从「真实」出发，经「真正地」变成纯粹的程度副词，又保留了「正是那一个」的第二重身份。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a thermometer pushed to its top mark.
core.cn: 核心意象：温度计被推到最高那一格。

branches.en: The degree branch: a portfolio called impressive.
branches.cn: 程度分支：被称作出色的作品集。

branches.en: The verb branch: very pleased with the result.
branches.cn: 动词分支：对结果非常满意。

branches.en: The pointing branch: the very book on the shelf.
branches.cn: 指认分支：架上正是那本书。

branches.en: The extreme branch: the very end of the cave.
branches.cn: 极端分支：洞穴的最深处。

branches.en: The emphasis branch: the very idea frightens him.
branches.cn: 强调分支：光是这个念头就让他害怕。

intro.en: There is no living prefix here; the old root ver- (true) survives mainly inside longer words.
intro.cn: 这个词没有可拆的活前缀，古词根 ver-（真实）主要存活在更长的词里。

latinIntro.en: Latin verus gave French verai and English very; the same root also built verify, verity, and verdict.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 verus 派生法语 verai 与英语 very，同一词根还构成 verify、verity、verdict。

items.example: Ver- hides inside very as the sense of the genuine.
items.exampleCN: ver- 藏在 very 里，是「真正」的含义。

items.example: Very first meant in a true way.
items.exampleCN: very 最初表示「以真实的方式」。

items.example: We verify the figures before printing.
items.exampleCN: 付印前我们会核实这些数字。

items.meaning: a true saying by a jury
items.example: The jury returned a verdict of not guilty.
The verity of the claim was never in doubt.
items.exampleCN: 这一说法的真实性从未被怀疑。

items.example: She enjoyed the trip very much.
They wore the very same coat.
items.exampleCN: 他们穿的是完全相同的外套。

items.example: The film was not very long.

definition_zh: 景色；看法；视野；观看
definition_en: what can be seen from a place, or the way a person thinks about something
core_image: 推开旅馆的窗，整片湖面铺在眼前
scene: 旅馆房间在六楼，她拉开窗帘，整片湖面就铺在眼前。The room has a fine view of the lake and the hills behind it.
sceneCN: 这里 view 是「景色」（第 1 个义项：从某处能看到的景象）；句意为这个房间能看到湖与湖后群山的好景色。推开窗后铺开的画面正是这个词的核心。

derivatives.zh: 加后缀 -er 构成，义为「观众；观看者」
合成词，义为「观点；视角」
加前缀 re- 构成，义为「回顾；评论」

senses.title: What can be seen from a place
senses.definition: the whole scene that a place allows you to see
senses.definitionCN: 从某一位置能看到的整体景象
senses.example: The room has a fine view of the lake and the hills behind it.
senses.exampleCN: 这个房间能看到湖与湖后群山的好景色。
senses.why: To look out is to see; the scene laid before the eyes is the view.
senses.whyCN: 向外看是「看」这个动作，而铺在眼前的那片景象就是 view。

senses.title: A person’s opinion about something
senses.definition: a particular way of thinking about a matter
senses.definitionCN: 对某事的特定想法
senses.example: In my view the plan costs too much.
senses.exampleCN: 在我看来这个计划花费太高。
senses.why: The eye and the mind use one word: what you see from where you stand is what you think from where you stand.
senses.whyCN: 眼睛与头脑共用一个词：从哪个位置看，就从哪个位置想。

senses.title: The range within which something can be seen
senses.definition: the area that can be seen from a point, or the chance to see something
senses.definitionCN: 从一个位置能看见的区域，或看见某物的机会
senses.example: The ship came into view at dawn.
senses.exampleCN: 黎明时那艘船出现在视野里。
senses.why: A view is not only the picture but the space in which the picture can appear.
senses.whyCN: view 不只是那幅画面，也是画面得以出现的空间。

senses.title: To look at something carefully
senses.definition: to watch or examine something, especially for a purpose
senses.definitionCN: 有目的地观看或检查某物
senses.example: The committee viewed the site before voting.
senses.exampleCN: 委员会在表决前察看了现场。
senses.why: The noun gives a verb: to give a thing your view is to view it.
senses.whyCN: 名词派生动词：把目光给某物，就是去观看它。

senses.title: To regard something in a certain way
senses.definition: to think of something as being a particular thing
senses.definitionCN: 把某物视为某一性质的事物
senses.example: Many people view silence as agreement.
senses.exampleCN: 很多人把沉默看作同意。
senses.why: When the mind places a thing before itself, the same verb names the judgment.
senses.whyCN: 当头脑把一物摆在自身之前端详时，这个动词也用来表示判断。

senses.title: What can be seen in a picture or on a screen
senses.definition: the scene shown in an image, drawing, or display
senses.definitionCN: 图像、图画或屏幕中显示的场景
senses.example: The drawing shows the house from the front view.
senses.exampleCN: 这幅画从正面视角画了这座房子。
senses.why: Images repeat the word, naming the angle from which a scene is drawn.
senses.whyCN: 图像沿用了这个词，用来指画面取景的角度。

intro.en: View comes from Old French veue, a seeing, from Latin videre, to see.
intro.cn: view 来自古法语 veue（看见），源头是拉丁语 videre（看）。

items.en: Videre meant to see, and its past participle visus gave the noun of seeing.
items.cn: videre 意为看见，其过去分词 visus 派生出「所见」的名词。

items.en: French veue named the act of seeing and the sight itself.
items.cn: 法语 veue 既指看的动作，也指所见之物。

items.en: English borrowed it as vewe, later spelled view.
items.cn: 英语借入作 vewe，后来拼作 view。

items.en: The sense widened from sight to the scene before the eyes.
items.cn: 词义从「看」扩展到眼前的景象。

items.en: Opinion and examination joined the family, giving in my view and to view a site.
items.cn: 「看法」与「检查」加入词族，产生 in my view 与 view a site。

note.en: The first group holds words built on view, the second the words for scenes and opinions.
note.cn: 第一组是由 view 构成的词，第二组是表示景象与看法的词。

entries.definition: a person who watches
a position from which one thinks
to look over again
more than one opinion
a place as it looks
the power or act of seeing
what one thinks
a broad look over an area

normalIntro.en: Latin to see becomes both the thing seen and the thought held: the eye and the mind share one short word.
normalIntro.cn: 拉丁语的「看」既成为所见之物，也成为所持之见：眼睛与头脑共用一个短词。

normal.en: View is short but the vowel is long: /vjuː/.
normal.cn: view 拼写不长，但元音读长音 /vjuː/。

normal.en: Viewer adds -er for the one watching.
normal.cn: viewer 加 -er 表示观看的人。

normal.en: Viewpoint joins view and point, a place to think from.
normal.cn: viewpoint 由 view 与 point 合成，指思考所站的位置。

normal.en: Review begins with re-, to look again.
normal.cn: review 以 re- 开头，意为再看一遍。

normal.en: In my view is the standard way to give an opinion.
normal.cn: 给出看法时常用 in my view。

abstract.en: See curtains pulled back onto a wide lake.
abstract.cn: 想窗帘被拉开，露出一整片湖。

abstract.en: Picture two people on one hill looking different ways.
abstract.cn: 想一座山上两个人朝不同方向看。

abstract.en: Hear someone say that is how I see it.
abstract.cn: 听有人说，我就是这么看的。

examples.en: From the top of the tower the whole town is in view.
examples.cn: 从塔顶望去，整座小镇尽收眼底。

examples.en: The council viewed the plans with suspicion.
examples.cn: 议会带着怀疑看待这些计划。

examples.en: Her view of the matter changed after the meeting.
examples.cn: 会议之后，她对这件事的看法变了。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「V 呦」——站在山顶比个 V，呦，风景真好看。

root: 拉丁语 videre（看见）→ 过去分词 visus → 古法语 veue → 英语 view

sensesIntro.en: The word starts with a scene from a window and ends with a judgment in the mind; the verb bridges watching and regarding.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个词从窗外的景象开始，走到心中的判断；动词则连接了「观看」与「看作」。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a lake spread out beyond an open window.
core.cn: 核心意象：敞开的窗外铺开一片湖。

branches.en: The window branch: lake and hills from a room.
branches.cn: 窗户分支：房里望见的湖与山。

branches.en: The opinion branch: my view on the cost.
branches.cn: 看法分支：我对花费的看法。

branches.en: The range branch: a ship heaving into sight.
branches.cn: 范围分支：船驶入视野。

branches.en: The looking branch: viewing a site, and viewing silence as consent.
branches.cn: 观看分支：察看现场，把沉默看作同意。

branches.en: The drawing branch: a house shown from the front view.
branches.cn: 绘图分支：房子的正面视图。

intro.en: The root vid-, vis-, view- means to see; -er, -point, and re- extend the word.
intro.cn: 词根 vid-、vis-、view- 意为看见，-er、-point、re- 扩展这个词。

latinIntro.en: Latin videre, to see, passed through French as veue and reaches English as view, with its relatives visible and vision.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 videre（看见）经法语 veue 传入英语成为 view，同族还有 visible 与 vision。

items.example: A viewpoint is where one stands to think.
items.exampleCN: viewpoint 是思考所站的位置。

items.example: Preview shows the work before release.
items.exampleCN: preview 在上映前展示作品。
visible 与词根 vis- 同源。

definition_zh: 村庄；村子；（统称）村民
definition_en: a small settlement in the countryside, smaller than a town
core_image: 山谷里几十间灰瓦房，一条路从村口穿过
scene: 地图上那一点很小，但走进去有小学、有杂货铺、有坐在门口的老人。The village has one school, one shop, and two hundred people.
sceneCN: 这里 village 是「村庄」（第 1 个义项：比城镇小的乡村聚落）；句意为这个村子有一所学校、一家店、两百口人。山谷里几十间灰瓦房的画面就是这个词的意思。

derivatives.zh: 加后缀 -er 构成，义为「村民」
villager 的复数，义为「村民们」
加 -like 构成，义为「村庄般的」

senses.title: A small country settlement
senses.definition: a small group of houses in the countryside
senses.definitionCN: 乡村中一小片房屋构成的聚落
senses.example: The village has one school, one shop, and two hundred people.
senses.exampleCN: 这个村子有一所学校、一家店、两百口人。
senses.why: Latin villa was a country house, and a cluster of them became a village.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 villa 是乡间宅院，几座聚在一起就成了村庄。

senses.title: The people living there
senses.definition: the inhabitants of such a place, taken together
senses.definitionCN: 住在这样一个地方的人们，作为整体看
senses.example: The whole village came out to watch the parade.
senses.exampleCN: 全村人都出来看游行。
senses.why: Once houses stand together, the word can mean the people inside them.
senses.whyCN: 房屋一旦聚在一起，这个词就可以指住在里面的人。

senses.title: A district inside a city
senses.definition: a small area of a city that feels like a country village
senses.definitionCN: 城市里像乡村村庄的一小片区域
senses.example: Greenwich Village is famous for its small streets.
senses.exampleCN: 格林尼治村以其小街巷闻名。
senses.why: City planners borrowed the warm image of the country village for an urban quarter.
senses.whyCN: 城市规划者借用了乡村村庄的温暖意象来称呼城市街区。

senses.title: A settlement in a game or story
senses.definition: a small settlement used as a setting in games and fiction
senses.definitionCN: 游戏与虚构作品中作为场景的小聚落
senses.example: Players return to the village to trade supplies.
senses.exampleCN: 玩家回到村庄交换补给。
senses.why: Any small settlement in an imagined world takes the same name.
senses.whyCN: 想象世界里的任何小聚落都沿用这个名字。

senses.title: The adjective use in names
senses.definition: used before another noun to describe something belonging to a village
senses.definitionCN: 放在另一名词前，表示属于村庄的
senses.example: Village life moves more slowly than city life.
senses.exampleCN: 乡村生活比城市生活节奏更慢。
senses.why: A settled place easily turns into a describing word.
senses.whyCN: 一个固定的地方很容易转成修饰用的词。

intro.en: Village grew from Latin villa, a country estate, through French into English.
intro.cn: village 从拉丁语 villa（乡间庄园）经法语进入英语。

items.en: Villa was a country house with land around it.
items.cn: villa 是带有周围土地的乡间宅邸。

items.en: Villaticus described what belonged to such an estate.
items.cn: villaticus 形容属于这种庄园的东西。

items.en: French village named the group of houses that grew near a villa.
items.cn: 法语 village 指在庄园附近发展起来的房屋群。

items.en: English village covered a small settlement with a church.
items.cn: 中世纪英语 village 指带教堂的小聚落。

items.en: The word later lent itself to city quarters and game settings.
items.cn: 后来这个词也被用于城市街区与游戏场景。

note.en: The first group holds the villa family, the second the nearby words for settlements.
note.cn: 第一组是 villa 词族，第二组是表示聚落的相近词。

normalIntro.en: A villa is one house; a village is the ring of houses that gathers around it.
normalIntro.cn: villa 是一座宅子，village 是围着它聚成的房群。

normal.en: Villa plus -age gives village, as in village of houses.
normal.cn: villa 加 -age 得 village，即一片房舍。

normal.en: Add -er for villager, the person; keep the g.
normal.cn: 加 -er 得 villager（村民），注意 g 保留。

normal.en: The plural adds -s to the whole word: villages.
normal.cn: 复数在整词后加 -s：villages。

normal.en: Think small: one school, one shop, one road.
normal.cn: 往小处想：一所学校、一家店、一条路。

normal.en: Greenwich Village shows the word used inside a city.
normal.cn: Greenwich Village 展示了城市内的用法。

abstract.en: See grey roofs in a valley with one road through.
abstract.cn: 想山谷里一片灰屋顶，一条路穿过。

abstract.en: Hear a bell that the whole valley can hear.
abstract.cn: 听一口全谷都听得见的钟。

abstract.en: Picture the old men at the doorway watching the road.
abstract.cn: 想老人们坐在门口望着那条路。

examples.en: They moved from the city to a small village.
examples.cn: 他们从城市搬到了一个小村庄。

examples.en: Every villager helped rebuild the bridge.
examples.cn: 每位村民都参与了修桥。

examples.en: The village is quiet except on market day.
examples.cn: 这个村子除了集市日都很安静。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「为立志」——年轻人为了立志出山，把家乡的小村庄留在身后。

root: 拉丁语 villa（乡间庄园）→ 古法语 village → 中世纪英语 village

sensesIntro.en: One country estate grows into a cluster of houses, then into the people, then into a street of the big city.
sensesIntro.cn: 一座乡间庄园长成一片房舍，再长成住在里面的人，最后长成大城市里的一条街。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: grey roofs in a valley, one road through.
core.cn: 核心意象：山谷里的灰屋顶与一条穿村的路。

branches.en: The place branch: one school and two hundred people.
branches.cn: 地点分支：一所学校与两百个人。

branches.en: The people branch: the whole village at the parade.
branches.cn: 人物分支：全村的看游行的人。

branches.en: The city branch: small streets called a village.
branches.cn: 城市分支：被称为「村」的小街巷。

branches.en: The story branch: players trading in the village.
branches.cn: 故事分支：玩家在村里交易。

branches.en: The naming branch: village life in a report.
branches.cn: 命名分支：报道中的乡村生活。

intro.en: The stem vill- means a country estate; -age makes a collective noun, -er makes the person.
intro.cn: 词干 vill- 意为乡间庄园，-age 构成集合名词，-er 构成表人的词。

latinIntro.en: Latin villa gave French village and English village, with villager built on top.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 villa 派生法语 village 与英语 village，再由此构成 villager。

items.example: Vill- points to a house in the fields.
items.exampleCN: vill- 指向田野中的宅子。

items.example: Village is a group of villas.
A villager lives in the village.
A villagelike street in the old town.
items.exampleCN: 老城里一条像村庄的街。

items.example: A village grows into a town.
They rented a villa by the sea.
items.exampleCN: 他们在海边租了一栋别墅。

items.example: A village inside a city is a neighbourhood.

definition_zh: 访问；参观；拜访；探望；造访
definition_en: to go to see a person or a place, usually for a limited time and then come back
core_image: 提着礼物敲门，进屋坐一会儿，喝完茶再起身告辞
scene: 出差顺路，他拎着一盒点心敲开老师家的门，坐下喝了两杯茶才起身。On his way back from the meeting, he stopped to visit his old teacher.
sceneCN: 这里 visit 是「拜访」（第 1 个义项：到某人那里去看望）；句意为开完会往回走时，他顺道去看望了老老师。提着礼物敲门、坐下又告辞的那幅画就是这个词的印象。

derivatives.zh: 来访者；参观者
探访；视察；天罚的旧说法
来访的；客座的
重访；重新考虑

senses.title: To go and see a person
senses.definition: to go to a person and spend time with them, then leave again
senses.definitionCN: 到某人那里去，与他待上一段时间再离开
senses.example: On his way back from the meeting, he stopped to visit his old teacher.
senses.exampleCN: 开完会往回走时，他顺道去看望了自己的老老师。
senses.why: The oldest layer of the word is simply the act of going to see someone; the coming and going is part of it.
senses.whyCN: 这个词最古老的一层就是「前去看人」这一动作，来与去都包含在内。

senses.title: To go and see a place
senses.definition: to go to a building or town in order to look at it rather than live there
senses.definitionCN: 到某座建筑或城镇去看，而不是住在那里
senses.example: The class will visit the science museum on Friday morning.
senses.exampleCN: 这个班星期五上午将参观科学博物馆。
senses.why: A place is visited the same way a person is: one goes there, looks, and comes away.
senses.whyCN: 地方与人一样被「拜访」：去一趟、看一看，然后离开。

senses.title: To stay somewhere for a time
senses.definition: to spend a period of time at a place as a guest rather than as a resident
senses.definitionCN: 作为客人而不是住客在某地停留一段时间
senses.example: My cousin came to visit for the whole winter holiday.
senses.exampleCN: 我表弟整个寒假都来家里作客。
senses.why: The sense stretches from a short call to a whole season, because what matters is being a guest, not the length.
senses.whyCN: 这层意思从短暂的拜访延伸到整个季节，因为关键在于是客人，而不在时间长短。

senses.title: To go to a doctor or clinic
senses.definition: to go to a doctor, dentist or clinic for help rather than having them come to you
senses.definitionCN: 自己去医生、牙医或诊所那里求助，而不是让对方上门
senses.example: You should visit a dentist if the pain lasts more than three days.
senses.exampleCN: 如果疼痛超过三天，就应该去看牙医。
senses.why: Diagnosis happens by going to the office, so the same plain verb covers a medical appointment.
senses.whyCN: 诊断发生在去诊所的过程中，于是同一个朴素动词也承担了看病的说法。

senses.title: To check a place or a site
senses.definition: to go to a place in order to inspect or check it, in official or technical use
senses.definitionCN: 为检查而前往某处，用于公务或技术语境
senses.example: Inspectors will visit the factory twice next month.
senses.exampleCN: 检查人员下个月将到工厂巡查两次。
senses.why: Official inspection is a visit with a purpose, so the verb took on a checking shade without changing shape.
senses.whyCN: 公务检查是一次带有目的的造访，于是这个词在不改变形态的情况下带上了核查的意味。

senses.title: To come upon someone in trouble
senses.definition: in older use, of trouble or punishment, to come upon someone
senses.definitionCN: 旧时用法，指灾祸或惩罚降临到某人身上
senses.example: A great famine visited the region that year.
senses.exampleCN: 那一年大饥荒降临到这一地区。
senses.why: In older writing an affliction is said to visit people, as if it were a grim guest paying a call.
senses.whyCN: 在较早的文本里，灾祸被说成「造访」人，仿佛它是一位阴沉的不速之客。

intro.en: Visit comes from Latin visitare, to go to see, which grew from videre, to see.
intro.cn: visit 来自拉丁语 visitare（前去看望），而后者又由 videre（看）生长而来。

items.en: Videre meant to see, and its frequent form visitare meant to go and see often.
items.cn: videre 意为看，其反复体 visitare 意为常常前去看。

items.en: In Roman use visitare covered visiting the sick and inspecting a province as well as private calls.
items.cn: 在罗马用法里，visitare 既包括探望病人、巡视行省，也包括私人拜访。

items.en: Old French visiter carried the verb into English, with the sense of paying a call.
items.cn: 古法语 visiter 把这个动词带入英语，含义是登门探望。

items.en: English widened it to buildings, towns and museums, all of which can be gone to and looked at.
items.cn: 英语把它扩展到建筑、城镇与博物馆，这些都可以去到并观看。

items.en: The noun visit appeared beside the verb, so English now says either pay a visit or visit.
items.cn: 名词 visit 与动词并行出现，所以现代英语既说 pay a visit，也直接说 visit。

note.en: The first group gathers the see-family, the second the words that describe different kinds of call.
note.cn: 第一组收「看」词族，第二组收描述不同性质造访的词。

entries.definition: The person who makes a visit.
An official or solemn visit, sometimes a punishing one.
To visit again, or to study something again.
Sight itself, from the same Latin verb to see.
To pay a short visit to someone.
To travel through a place looking at its sights.
To be present at an event rather than to look at a place.
To visit briefly and without an appointment.

normalIntro.en: One Latin verb to see sits under visit, visitation and vision, so the image of looking is never far away.
normalIntro.cn: 拉丁语「看」这个动词藏在 visit、visitation 与 vision 之下，所以「看」的画面一直不远。

normal.en: Vis- means to see; visit is going there so as to see.
normal.cn: vis- 是「看」，visit 就是到那里去看。

normal.en: The visitor is the person; the visit is the call itself.
normal.cn: visitor 是人，visit 是这次造访本身。

normal.en: Pay a visit is the noun phrase; visit a friend is the verb.
normal.cn: pay a visit 用名词，visit a friend 用动词。

normal.en: Visitation is the heavy official version of the same act.
normal.cn: visitation 是同一动作里带有官方重量的版本。

normal.en: Vision shares the root and means the seeing, not the going.
normal.cn: vision 与它同根，指看的能力，而不是去的过程。

abstract.en: See a doorbell pressed once and a cup of tea poured.
abstract.cn: 想门铃被按一下，随后一杯茶被斟满。

abstract.en: Feel the short pause between greeting and leaving.
abstract.cn: 感受打招呼与告辞之间那段短短的停留。

abstract.en: Picture a guest chair that is never moved into the room.
abstract.cn: 想一把始终没被搬进屋里的客座椅子。

examples.en: We visit my grandmother every Sunday afternoon.
examples.cn: 我们每个星期天下午都去看望奶奶。

examples.en: The visitors were asked to sign the book at the door.
examples.cn: 来访者被要求在门口的本子上签名。

examples.en: A doctor visited him twice during the night.
examples.cn: 夜里医生去看过他两次。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「威兹特」——威兹特先生每次上门都提着礼物，一坐就是一下午。

root: 拉丁语 videre（看）→ 反复体 visitare（常常去看）→ 古法语 visiter → 英语 visit；同源词有 vision、visible。

sensesIntro.en: The verb starts at going to see a person, then spreads to places, to being a guest, to seeing a doctor, to inspecting, and to trouble that comes like a visitor.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个动词从「去看一个人」出发，再延伸到看地方、作客、看医生、巡查，以及像来客一样降临的灾祸。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand reaching for a doorbell.
core.cn: 核心意象：伸手按门铃。

branches.en: The person branch: a stop at an old teacher’s door.
branches.cn: 人的分支：在老师门口停一停。

branches.en: The place branch: a museum tour and a winter stay.
branches.cn: 地方分支：参观博物馆与整个寒假的作客。

branches.en: The medical branch: visiting a dentist.
branches.cn: 医疗分支：去看牙医。

branches.en: The inspection branch: inspectors arriving to check.
branches.cn: 巡查分支：检查人员上门核查。

branches.en: The old trouble branch: a famine that visits.
branches.cn: 旧的灾祸分支：饥荒的降临。

intro.en: Vis- is the Latin look; -it is the ending of the past participle, and ordinary English endings build the family.
intro.cn: vis- 是拉丁语的「看」，-it 是过去分词词尾，普通英语后缀再扩展出整个词族。

latinIntro.en: Latin videre and its frequent form visitare are both well recorded, and so is the noun visitatio.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 videre 及其反复体 visitare 都有文献记录，名词 visitatio 亦然。

items.example: The root is the seed of the family.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根是词族的种子。

items.example: It also gives vision and visible.
items.exampleCN: 它也给出 vision 与 visible。

items.example: The longer verb is the direct source.
items.exampleCN: 这个较长的动词是直接来源。

items.example: It forms visiting, as in a visiting team.

definition_zh: 嗓音；声音；意见；发言权；语态
definition_en: the sound made when a person speaks or sings, using the vocal cords
core_image: 喉咙里的声带一收一放，空气被推成能辨认出是谁的声音
scene: 电话那头只说了半句，他就听出是谁，那个声音听过太多次了。Her voice was so low on the phone that I could hardly hear her.
sceneCN: 这里 voice 是「嗓音」（第 1 个义项：说话或唱歌时嗓子发出的声音）；句意为她在电话里的声音低得几乎听不见。声带一收一放的那幅画就是这个词的印象。

pos.zh: 嗓音；声音；意见；发言权；语态

derivatives.zh: 有声的；浊音的
无声的；清音的；无发言权的
浊化；配音
声音的；发声的
发声；用言语表达

senses.title: The sound of speaking or singing
senses.definition: the sound produced in the throat when a person speaks, sings or shouts
senses.definitionCN: 人说话、唱歌或喊叫时在喉部发出的声音
senses.example: Her voice was so low on the phone that I could hardly hear her.
senses.exampleCN: 她在电话里的声音低得几乎听不见。
senses.why: The Latin word for voice named the sound itself before it named anything figurative.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语里的这个词，先指声音本身，之后才被引申他用。

senses.title: An opinion expressed
senses.definition: the opinion of a person or a group, especially as expressed aloud
senses.definitionCN: 人或群体的意见，尤指说出来的
senses.example: The voice of the staff was finally heard at the meeting.
senses.exampleCN: 员工的声音终于在会上被听到了。
senses.why: What is said aloud is the voice of the one saying it, so the sound stands for the view.
senses.whyCN: 说出口的话就是说话者的声音，于是声音代替了观点。

senses.title: The right to speak and be counted
senses.definition: the right or chance to express an opinion and influence a decision
senses.definitionCN: 表达意见并影响决定的权利或机会
senses.example: Students now have a voice in how the library is run.
senses.exampleCN: 学生如今在图书馆的管理上有发言权。
senses.why: If an opinion is a voice, being allowed to speak is having a voice; the right follows from the sound.
senses.whyCN: 如果意见就是声音，那么被允许开口就是有声音，权利从声音里推演出来。

senses.title: The verb, to put into words
senses.definition: to express a feeling or opinion in words
senses.definitionCN: 用言语表达感受或意见
senses.example: She voiced doubts that no one else dared to raise.
senses.exampleCN: 她说出了别人不敢提的疑问。
senses.why: English turns many nouns into verbs without change, so the thing you have can become the thing you do.
senses.whyCN: 英语常让名词原封不动地变作动词，于是你拥有的东西就变成你做的动作。

senses.title: A grammatical form
senses.definition: in grammar, the form that shows whether the subject acts or is acted upon
senses.definitionCN: 语法中表示主语是施动还是受动的形式
senses.example: The report was rewritten in the passive voice.
senses.exampleCN: 这份报告改用了被动语态。
senses.why: Roman grammarians spoke of the verb’s kinds of vox, and the term was carried into English grammar.
senses.whyCN: 罗马语法学家谈论动词的种种 vox，这个术语被带入英语语法。

senses.title: In music and phonetics, the singing part
senses.definition: a line of music for singing, or the buzzing quality of certain speech sounds
senses.definitionCN: 音乐中供唱的声部，或某些语音的带声性质
senses.example: The four voices came in one after another, none too loud.
senses.exampleCN: 四个声部依次进入，都不太响。
senses.why: A part written for singers takes the name of what singers use, and phonetics borrows it for the same reason.
senses.whyCN: 写给歌者的声部取用了歌者所用之物的名字，语音学也出于同样理由借用它。

intro.en: Voice comes from Latin vox, the word for voice, through Old French voiz.
intro.cn: voice 来自拉丁语 vox（声音、话语），经古法语 voiz 传入英语。

items.en: Vox meant both the voice and what it says, and it was used for a call or an order.
items.cn: vox 既指声音，也指声音说出的话，还用作呼喊或命令。

items.en: Roman grammarians used vox to describe the forms of the verb, and the idea of grammatical voice starts here.
items.cn: 罗马语法学家用 vox 描述动词的形式，语法上的「语态」这一观念在此起步。

items.en: Old French voiz carried the word, and the spelling was fixed in English as voice.
items.cn: 古法语 voiz 把这个词带过来，英语定下 voice 的拼法。

items.en: English extended it from sound to opinion, then to the right to speak: a voice in the matter.
items.cn: 英语把它从声音扩展到意见，再扩展到发言的权利：在这件事上有声音。

items.en: Printing and later broadcasting made the voice of the people a familiar phrase.
items.cn: 印刷术与后来的广播使「人民的声音」成为常见说法。

note.en: The first group gathers the calling and voicing family, the second the words for sound and for speech rights.
note.cn: 第一组收发声与呼叫的词族，第二组收表示声音与发言权的词。

entries.definition: The plural and the third person singular.
entries.definitionCN: 复数与第三人称单数形式

entries.definition: Uttered aloud, or produced with the vocal cords buzzing.
Relating to the voice, and also outspoken.
A speech sound made with an open mouth.
Anything the ear can hear, voices included.
The colour or feeling of a voice.
A view held, whether spoken or not.
The absence of any voice.

normalIntro.en: One Latin noun for the voice supplies the sound, the opinion, the right to speak, the verb and the grammar.
normalIntro.cn: 一个拉丁名词同时供给了声音、意见、发言权、动词形式与语法术语。

normal.en: Voice is both what comes out and the right to let it come out.
normal.cn: voice 既是发出的声音，也是允许发出的权利。

normal.en: Raise your voice is louder; find your voice is braver.
normal.cn: raise your voice 是提高音量，find your voice 是敢于表达。

normal.en: The verb is regular: voiced, voicing.
normal.cn: 动词变化规则：voiced、voicing。

normal.en: The passive voice moves the doer to the end.
normal.cn: 被动语态把施动者挪到句末。

normal.en: Vocal and vowel come from the same root.
normal.cn: vocal 与 vowel 同根。

abstract.en: See a throat move once and a room go quiet.
abstract.cn: 想喉咙动一下，房间就静下来。

abstract.en: Hear a phone voice and know the speaker at once.
abstract.cn: 听电话里的声音，立刻认出是谁。

abstract.en: Picture a raised hand that is given the floor.
abstract.cn: 想一只举起的手被准许发言。

examples.en: He lowered his voice so the children would not hear.
examples.cn: 他压低声音，免得孩子听见。

examples.en: Local residents have no voice in the planning process.
examples.cn: 当地居民在规划过程中没有发言权。

examples.en: She voiced her concern about the new rules.
examples.cn: 她说出了对新规定的担忧。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「我嘶」——嗓子一使劲，我嘶了一声，屋里人都回头看。

root: 拉丁语 vox（声音；话语）→ 古法语 voiz → 英语 voice；同源词有 vocal、vowel、vocation。

sensesIntro.en: The word runs from the sound in the throat to an opinion, to the right to speak, to the verb of saying, to grammar and music.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个词从喉咙里的声音一路走到意见、发言权、动词「道出」，再到语法与音乐。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: vocal cords pushing air into a known sound.
core.cn: 核心意象：声带把空气推成熟悉的声音。

branches.en: The sound branch: a low voice on the phone.
branches.cn: 声音分支：电话里低低的嗓音。

branches.en: The opinion branch: staff heard at last.
branches.cn: 意见分支：员工终于被听到。

branches.en: The rights branch: students in library decisions.
branches.cn: 权利分支：学生在图书馆事务中的作用。

branches.en: The language branch: voiced doubts and the passive form.
branches.cn: 语言分支：道出的疑问与被动形式。

branches.en: The music branch: four parts entering one by one.
branches.cn: 音乐分支：四个声部依次进入。

intro.en: The voicing root voc- takes -al, -ize and -ation, and appears in voice, vocal and vowel.
intro.cn: 发声词根 voc- 加 -al、-ize、-ation 等后缀，出现在 voice、vocal、vowel 之中。

latinIntro.en: Latin vox with its stem voc- is recorded, and so is the adjective vocalis.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 vox 及其词干 voc- 有文献记录，形容词 vocalis 亦然。

items.example: It is the root of the family.
The noun itself came into English.
items.exampleCN: 这个名词本身进入了英语。

definition_zh: 等；等候；等待；（旧）埋伏；（英）侍奉
definition_en: to stay somewhere or hold back from acting until something happens
core_image: 一个人站在门口，眼睛盯着路的尽头
scene: 雨天的公交站台上，几个人缩着肩，不时探头看远处的车灯。We waited nearly an hour for the last bus to come.
sceneCN: 这里 wait 是「等候」（第 1 个义项：留在原处直到某事发生）；句意为为了最后一班车，我们等了将近一小时。站在站台上盯着路尽头的那副样子，就是这个词的形象。

derivatives.zh: wait 加 -er 构成，义为「侍者；服务员」
waiter 加 -ess 构成，义为「女服务员」
加 -ing 构成，义为「等待」
a- 与 wait 复合，义为「等候（某事）」

senses.title: To stay until something happens
senses.definition: to stay in a place or delay action until something expected happens
senses.definitionCN: 留在某处或推迟行动，直到期待之事发生
senses.example: We waited nearly an hour for the last bus to come.
senses.exampleCN: 为了最后一班车，我们等了将近一小时。
senses.why: The word came from a Germanic verb meaning to watch or to keep guard; a watcher stands still and that is what a waiter does.
senses.whyCN: 这个词来自日耳曼语动词，意为观望、守候；观望的人站着不动，等待之人正是如此。

senses.title: To delay something
senses.definition: to put off doing something until a later moment
senses.definitionCN: 把某事推到稍后再做
senses.example: Wait until the paint is dry before you touch it.
senses.exampleCN: 等漆干了再碰。
senses.why: If you stand guard you do nothing for a while, so the verb also means to hold an action back.
senses.whyCN: 守候的人有一阵子什么都不做，于是动词也指把行动按住。

senses.title: To be ready to serve
senses.definition: in the older use, to attend on someone or to serve at table
senses.definitionCN: 旧时用法指在旁伺候，或侍奉餐桌
senses.example: He waited at table in the evenings to pay for his studies.
senses.exampleCN: 他晚上在餐桌旁伺候，以支付学费。
senses.why: A servant waits, meaning attends nearby and watches for a sign; the waiter of a restaurant still carries that meaning.
senses.whyCN: 仆役「候着」，即在一旁看着等吩咐；餐厅的侍者仍带着这层意思。

senses.title: To lie in ambush
senses.definition: in older use, to lie hidden and watch for a chance to strike
senses.definitionCN: 旧时用法指藏起来，等机会出手
senses.example: The hunters waited in the reeds for the birds to land.
senses.exampleCN: 猎人们藏在芦苇里等鸟落下。
senses.why: The original sense of watching has a dark side: a watcher may be hidden and watching for prey.
senses.whyCN: 观望的本义有一个阴暗面：观望者也可能藏着看猎物。

senses.title: A period of waiting
senses.definition: the time spent waiting, or the act of waiting itself
senses.definitionCN: 等待所花的时间，或等待这一行为
senses.example: There was a long wait before the results were announced.
senses.exampleCN: 结果公布之前有一段漫长的等待。
senses.why: The noun turns the act into a stretch of time that can be counted or complained about.
senses.whyCN: 名词把这一行为变成一段可以计数、可以抱怨的时间。

senses.title: The phrase wait and see
senses.definition: in the fixed phrase, to take no action and watch how things turn out
senses.definitionCN: 固定说法里指暂不行动，看事情如何发展
senses.example: The doctor said we should wait and see for a week.
senses.exampleCN: 医生说我们先观察一周再说。
senses.why: Watching and holding back are the two halves of the verb; the phrase puts both together.
senses.whyCN: 观望与按住正是这个动词的两半，这个短语把两半合在一起。

intro.en: Wait comes from a Germanic verb meaning to watch or to keep guard, borrowed through Old French.
intro.cn: wait 来自日耳曼语表示观望、守候的动词，经古法语借入英语。

items.en: A Germanic root for watching produced a verb meaning keep guard.
items.cn: 日耳曼语表示观望的词根产生了一个意为守候的动词。

items.en: Old French waitier or guaitier meant to watch, and to lie in wait.
items.cn: 古法语 waitier 或 guaitier 意为观望，也指埋伏。

items.en: English borrowed the word as a verb of watching and ambush in the north of France.
items.cn: 英语在法国北部方言中借入这个词，用于观望与埋伏。

items.en: The sense shifted to staying still for an expected event, which is now the main meaning.
items.cn: 词义转到为期待之事留在原处，这成为今天的主要含义。

items.en: Service at table kept a separate sense, and the noun waiter came from it.
items.cn: 侍奉餐桌保留了另一支义项，名词 waiter 由此而来。

note.en: The first group holds the family and the look-alike, the second the words for staying and for expecting.
note.cn: 第一组收同族词与形近词，第二组收停留与预期的近义词。

entries.definition: The third person of the verb and the plural of the noun.
The past tense and past participle.
A different word for heaviness, with the same sound.
A formal verb meaning to wait for, used without a preposition.
entries.definitionCN: 正式动词，义为等候，后面不再加 for。

entries.definition: To think something will happen, without staying in place.
entries.definitionCN: 认为某事会发生，不必留在原处。

entries.definition: To put something off, often without intending to.
entries.definitionCN: 推迟某事，常非出于自愿。

entries.definition: To stay on longer than needed, without a clear purpose.
To remain in a place, whether or not one is waiting.

normalIntro.en: Watch, then stand, then serve: the whole family grows from keeping an eye on something.
normalIntro.cn: 先是观望，再是站着，最后是伺候：整个词族都从「盯着看」长出来。

normal.en: Wait for someone, but await someone: await takes no for.
normal.cn: wait for someone，但 await someone：await 后面不加 for。

normal.en: Wait is also a noun: there was a long wait at the airport.
normal.cn: wait 也是名词：在机场等了很久。

normal.en: Waiter and waitress come from waiting at table.
normal.cn: waiter 与 waitress 来自在餐桌旁伺候。

normal.en: Weight sounds the same and means heaviness.
normal.cn: weight 同音，但意思是重量。

normal.en: Wait and see keeps both halves: watch and hold back.
normal.cn: wait and see 保留了两面：观望与按捺。

abstract.en: See a figure at a stop, eyes on the far end of the road.
abstract.cn: 想站台上一人，眼睛盯着路的尽头。

abstract.en: Hear a clock tick while nothing moves.
abstract.cn: 听钟表滴答，什么也没动。

abstract.en: Feel the small effort of not doing anything yet.
abstract.cn: 感受暂时不动手的那点用力。

examples.en: Please wait here while I fetch the key.
examples.cn: 我去拿钥匙，请在这里等一下。

examples.en: I can hardly wait for the holidays.
examples.cn: 我简直等不及放假了。

examples.en: The queue was long, but the wait was worth it.
examples.cn: 队伍很长，但等得值得。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「喂特」——喂，特地在这儿站着等你，别让我白等。

root: 日耳曼语 *waht-（观望、守夜）→ 古法语北部方言 waitier（观望、埋伏）→ 英语 wait。

sensesIntro.en: A watching verb splits into four: standing still, holding back an act, attending on someone, and lying hidden, before becoming a stretch of time.
sensesIntro.cn: 一个「观望」动词分成四路：站着不动、按住行动、在旁伺候、藏着伺机，最后又变成一段时间。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one person fixed at a stop, watching the road.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个人钉在站台上盯着路。

branches.en: The standing branch: an hour at the bus stop.
branches.cn: 守候分支：在车站等一小时。

branches.en: The delay branch: wait until the paint dries.
branches.cn: 推迟分支：等漆干了再说。

branches.en: The service branch: waiting at table.
branches.cn: 伺候分支：在餐桌旁伺候。

branches.en: The ambush branch: hunters hidden in reeds.
branches.cn: 埋伏分支：藏在芦苇里的猎人。

branches.en: The noun and the phrase: a long wait, and wait and see.
branches.cn: 名词与短语分支：漫长的等待，以及静观其变。

intro.en: Wait is short and English; -er, -ess and -ing do all the work of building the family.
intro.cn: wait 本身短小，词族全靠 -er、-ess、-ing 等词尾搭起来。

latinIntro.en: The root is Germanic, not Latin, so this entry lists no Latin word.
latinIntro.cn: 词根为日耳曼语而非拉丁语，故不列拉丁词条。

items.example: The verb is the base of the family.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词是词族的基底。

items.example: Wait for is the common pattern.
items.exampleCN: wait for 是最常见的搭配。

items.example: It forms wait on a guest.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 wait on a guest。
